When she told them that she was learning Spinjitzu from him until she left and created a new martial art, Catjitzu. She told them she would teach them if they did her a favor in return. When Wu asked what kind of favor it was, she explained that she needed a Cat-Eye Jewel that had been stolen from her, but she couldn't get to it because of magic. So she wanted to train them to take it for her. Although Wu wanted to continue on their original journey, Garmadon reminded him of his father's phrase that "the experiences you have on a journey are often more important than the destination." Wu finally considered it, and since he wanted to learn Catjitzu himself, he finally agreed with his brother.[18]

When Nineko told her brothers that she had to take a nap, Wu urged her to tell them more about their father and the Cat-Eye Jewel, but Nineko just told them to leave her house, which they did. Although Garmadon did not understand why she had to take a nap, Wu reminded him that there was a catnap and that the cats were active at night. Although Garmadon was suspicious of her, Wu told him she had saved them twice, and then the two boys were silent. Wu prepared fo the training session with some warm-ups, as he would do at home. Then they ate some of the food they had brought until the moon finally appeared. Suddenly, Nineko jumped down behind them, and the brothers demanded that she teach them something like that. Nineko then ordered them to climb the ladder to her house, which they did, and then pointed to a thick green twisted vine that extended from the deck to a tree in the distance. Garmadon wanted to try it first, but as he walked through the vine, he fell, holding only one hand. Wu immediately went to his aid and walked across the vine to his brother, but he slipped, crashed into Garmadon, and they both fell into the mud. When Garmadon was angry with him, Wu told him he just wanted to help. Nineko then told the younger brother that he should try harder and use his staff to keep his balance. Both brothers climbed on the vine again, and after further unsuccessful attempts, Garmadon finally succeeded. Wu, who concentrated as hard as he could not to disappoint, did it too.[19]

Another part of the training was jumping using Spinjitzu. Wu offered to go first this time. He immediately jumped up and used Spinjitzu, but lost control and bumped into a large tree. When Nineko told them she was taking a nap again, the two brothers, exhausted and covered in mud, unrolled their mats on the deck of her tree house and slept. In the morning, they washed their clothes and continued training. After an unsuccessful attempt to jump as high as Nineko with a tornado, the boys tried to get more information from her. For several days, Nineko did not answer their questions about their father and her training until she told them one day that their father had caught her stealing, but instead of punishing her, he started training her.[19]

In the following days, they trained again and always went to bed dirty. Wu was still trying to get information from Nineko and asked Garmadon how he should do it. When he asked her questions again, she told him she would tell them her story when they mastered to use Catjitzu.[19]

After the next few days of training, the two brothers finally completed all the tasks they had been given before and mastered Catjitzu. Wu immediately asked Nineko to tell them everything. She agreed, and explained to them that she had left because their father still thought she was just an ordinary thief. When she left for the house without a word, Garmadon sarcastically praised Wu, for which the younger brother was angry and asked him how he knew it was painful for her to talk about it. Garmadon told him he was too curious for his own good sometimes. Nineko then told them it was time to fulfill what they had promised and told them that they had to use their skills to climb the high mountain where the Cat-Eye Jewel was located. Then she returned to the house. Wu began to think about her, and although he tried to think that she had fulfilled her part of the deal and they should, he remembered that it was the same with Aspheera. However, in the end, he decided to keep the promise.[19]

Mission of the Cat-Eye Jewel[]

Both brothers climbed into the boat and crossed the lake. When they anchored on the shore, Wu heard rustling in a clump of reeds. He motioned for Garmadon to jump in, and they did. They landed directly on one of the warriors they had met before. Wu pinned him to the ground with his staff. When they forced him to talk, the warrior told them that he had been watching them for several days and explained that he was not the enemy, but Nineko.[19] The brothers gasped. Garmadon then went to look around to check if the warrior was alone, while Wu kept him on the ground with the staff pressed firmly on his chest. After Garmadon returned, the warrior offered to tell them the truth. Wu slowly removed the staff and let the warrior stand up. He then introduced himself, revealing his name to them, Dillon, and then told them he was a member of the Order of Felis, who guarded the Cat-Eye Jewel. He also explained to them that the Jewel could give each cat nine lives, which Wu couldn't believe arguing that he thought it was just a tale. After Dillon's next story, Wu began to doubt Nineko and that she had told them the truth before. When Dillon offered to take them to the Temple of Felis, where their leader would give them proof, Garmadon didn't want to hear about it, but Wu wasn't sure. He finally decided and replied to Dillon to go to the temple with him, though Garmadon did not agree. The brothers stared at each other fiercely. Garmadon finally decided to return to Nineko alone and was about to leave. Wu asked him if he was sure after everything they'd heard about her, but his older brother was adamant. As he boarded the boat and sailed away, Wu wondered if he would ever see him again.[20] Although Wu considered jumping into Garmadon's boat for a moment, he finally decided not to do it and let Garmadon find it out for himself. He was sure that as soon as his brother found out that Nineko was evil, he would return. Then he and Dillon left the mountain and entered the forest.[21]

After a short hike they got out of the woods to a clearing with a temple in the center. When Wu saw the tall tower, he was amazed at the way it was built. As they got closer, Wu saw hundreds of cats all around the temple. When they were at the tower, Wu asked Dillon what smelled there, what the warrior told him it was a cat toilet. Then they both jumped to the first floor, where Dillon showed Wu the training room. Suddenly a woman came to them and asked where the second ninja was. Dillon introduced Wu to her and revealed her name, Adara. He then told her that Garmadon had returned to Nineko. Adara then mentioned that they had to prepare for the attack, as she saw Nineko using some strange magic, perhaps summoning the monsters again. Wu then remembered the monster they had encountered in the forest and described it to the others, which convinced him that the beast had been summoned by Nineko. Dillon and Wu then climbed to the next floor, where the warrior introduced Wu to their leader, Komala. The old woman motioned for Wu to sit down and then showed him in the fire her story of how Nineko destroyed her village, and Komala then studied good magic to protect the Cat-Eye Jewel. After the story, Dillon announced that they should go to the mountain and wait there for Nineko and Garmadon, which Komala agreed to.[21]

Wu and Dillon then climbed down the temple and hurried toward the mountain. When they reached it, they saw three lines of guardians there. Adara then came and told them that one scout had seen Nineko and Garmadon coming. Wu, who underestimated the possible risks, tried to calm them down and told them that Nineko and Garmadon were only two against many warriors. Then he revealed to them his plan to get to Garmadon when they came and tell him the truth.[21]

A few moments later, Nineko and Garmadon appeared along with the green mist. Wu shouted at his brother that Nineko was a sorceress, but then he realized that Garmadon's eyes were green. Dillon made it clear that Nineko controlled him using magic. Wu then shouted at the cat ninja to release his brother and give up, as there were only two. Nineko found him right and then spread her umbrella. Big green drops raining from the sky turned into rain cats, which Dillon called the legendary Warriors of Felis.[21] Wu asked Dillon if Nineko wanted to use them to get the Cat-Eye Jewel, but he explained that even rain cats would not overcome protective spells and only wanted to use them to distract attention until Garmadon stole the Jewel.[22]

Wu knew he had to reach Garmadon and save him from Nineko's sorcery somehow. He then used Spinjitzu and hit the rain cats with a tornado, expecting them to burst into water droplets, but they stayed solid. Wu then asked how they could be defeated, but no one answered. He knocked a few of them aside, but more began to circle him at high speed. Wu tried to repel them with a tornado, but there were too many of them. Wu then forced himself to think about how to defeat the rain cats until he heard that Nineko had instructed Garmadon to bring her the Jewel. Wu began to spin again, but this time he used Catjitzu and jumped above the circle of cats, thinking that at least something good came out of Nineko. He landed in front of Garmadon and tried to explain to him that he was under some kind of spell, but his brother did not listen to him. Wu grabbed him by the shoulders and shook him, but Garmadon picked him up and flipped him backward. Then he ran toward the mountain, and Wu followed him. He thought he was the only one who could stop Garmadon, and he kept running. As he ran, he noticed the narrow wedges of rock sticking out of it and decided to use Catjitzu to climb to the top, just like his brother. Garmadon climbed the mountain first, and the two warriors guarding the Jewel turned their spears on him. Wu shouted at them so they wouldn't hurt Garmadon, thinking about what to do. The older brother, meanwhile, managed to defeat the guards and run to the Jewel, and Wu followed. They both reached the Jewel at once and reached for it. The brothers grappled for control it, but Wu felt the rocks underneath his feet crumble. Garmadon grabbed for the Jewel and both boys fell from the peak. Wu knew that the only way to land was to use Catjitzu, so he spun while shouting at his brother to do the same. Garmadon obeyed him and they both reached the ground. They immediately started fighting for the Jewel again, until the tangle of brothers broke up and they both somersaulted in different directions, while Wu held the Jewel in his hands. Dillon then told Wu to take the stone back while he and Adara took care of Garmadon.[22]

Wu immediately ran to the mountain, but Nineko jumped in front of him and told him that if he gave her the Jewel, she would remove the magical hold she had on Garmadon. Wu told her he didn't trust her, and she ran to him. Wu backflipped to get away and then turned and ran. He went to the edge of the ravine and skidded to a stop. Nineko came to him and demanded the Jewel, but then Garmadon appeared, who wanted the same thing. He immediately tackled Wu and the two boys nearly tumbled into the ravine again. Wu begged his brother to stop, but he didn't listen. He kicked Wu in the knees and the Jewel fell out of his hands. Nineko picked him up, but Garmadon wanted to take him. Wu laughed and told her she probably wasn't very good at casting spells. Garmadon then tackled Nineko and the Jewel fell out of her hands so Wu could pick it up. Nineko then tried to steal it from him, but she slipped and fell into the ravine. Although Wu was in a hurry to help her, he didn't make it.[22]

Wu gasped and raced away from the ravine, but Garmadon followed him. The rain cats have so far surrounded Wu on the other side. Wu clutched the Jewel to his chest and tried to persuade Garmadon to stop trying. But Garmadon was still under the spell and the rain cats pounced. Wu then spun, thinking he would at least die like a real ninja. At that time, however, the rain cats dissolved into a mist and Komala appeared between them. She then pointed a finger at Garmadon and lifted his curse. Wu thanked her and ran to Garmadon and hugged him. The younger brother then wanted to return the Cat-Eye Jewel to Komala, but Dillon asked the two boys if they could bring it back to the top of the mountain, as their ninja powers made it much easier. The brothers agreed and Garmadon then grabbed the Jewel from Wu and grinned, shouting that who would be first at the top wins. Garmadon took off and Wu smiled because he was happy his brother returned. Then he ran after his brother to the top.[23]

When they returned the Jewel back on the top, the brothers said goodbye to the Order of Felis and continued on their way to the Northern Ocean.

Stop in the village[]

Over the next five days of wandering in woods and fields, Wu and Garmadon talked about a lot of things, and when they had no more topics to talk to, Wu sang every song he remembered to make their journey shorter. As soon as he couldn't remember another, they started playing "I spy," though the older brother didn't like it very much. When Wu said for the third time that he spies something green, Garmadon was outraged, but Wu told him he had no ideas, as everything around them was green. Garmadon finally let it go and tried to guess. As the older brother gradually pointed to every tree he saw, the grinning Wu asked his brother if he wanted to give up. Garmadon agreed, and Wu pointed at the tree he was spying. Since the older brother no longer wanted to play the game, they began to think together about what to do next. When Garmadon began to complain again that they had to find the tea plant that would help him, even though he didn't need it, Wu preferred not to argue with him, knowing what his brother was like. However, once Garmadon began to suggest that they return, Wu tried to convince him that his father would stop training them and could not become Spinjitzu masters. Then he motioned for his brother to continue playing. Garmadon did, but when he smelled smoke and said he spies a village, Wu scolded him for not playing the game right way. But then he realized that Garmadon was pointing to the real village in front of them, and since they no longer had supplies, they decided to go there. Wu ran first and shouted at his brother that whoever would be there last was a slimy snake.[24]

Both brothers ran into the village at once. Wu noticed strange behavior in people, but he tried to be nice to them. He then asked Garmadon if he had noticed the villagers' strange behavior, but they both forgot when they smelled food. They followed their noses to the marketplace, and when they noticed the dumplings, they wanted to order at least a dozen. However, Wu realized that they had almost no money left and could only afford one dumpling. Garmadon told the old woman who was selling them, and although she didn't understand at first, she was finally going to get them one dumpling. Garmadon begged her to choose the biggest one, but Wu tried to persuade him to leave it at that and that they could buy a bunch of carrots as they were easier to share. But then the woman's granddaughter came to them and told the woman to give them a whole plate. Wu thanked her and introduced himself and his brother. The old woman and girl also introduced themselves as Obachan and Hana. Obachan then loaded them with a full plate, and Wu thanked them once again and explained that they no longer had any supplies. Then he asked them if anyone in the village needed an extra hand so they could make some money. When Obachan told them not to stay in the village, the boys asked why, and finally Hana explained that people were disappearing. Since the nearest village was one day away, Hana offered them to stay overnight in her brother's room, who had also disappeared. The two brothers then ate their dumplings and went with the women to their cottage.[24]

When they entered Shin's room, Hana wanted to bring them some extra blankets so that one of them could sleep on the floor. Garmadon jumped into a bed first, but Wu followed him, and since neither wanted to leave the comfortable bed, they decided to share it. However, Wu couldn't sleep because he was still thinking about talking to Obachan and Hana and asked Garmadon about it. However, his brother behaved indifferently, so Wu eventually gave up and they both fell asleep.[24]

While the brothers slept, Wu dreamed of finding the tea plant with Garmadon. Wu made tea from it and had Garmadon drink it. When the older brother did, his eyes glazed red and then grew to a huge size. Wu cried at him, but nothing helped. Then, he woke up shaking. He looked over at his brother, who was snoring next to him. But then he heard a call for help from the street. He immediately woke his brother and they both ran to the window. They saw little people on the street kidnapping a much bigger boy. Wu jumped out the window and Garmadon followed him. Both then used Spinjitzu to save the boy. Six small people attacked Wu from behind, hitting him behind the knees. Wu stumbled and then twirled around and kicked one. Garmadon then realized they were puppets, and when Wu grabbed one of them, he noticed. As he was in shock, he dropped the puppet and it and the others ran into the woods. The two brothers followed them, but they fell into the traps that were guarded there. However, both managed to break free and ran on. However, as the puppets disappeared, they decided to return, realizing that the women had not told them everything before.[25]

When they returned to the village, Hana ran to them and thanked them for saving Kenji. Wu then asked her to tell them what was going on. Hana nodded and all three entered the cottage. As they sat in the kitchen and Obachan brought them tea, Wu remembered the dream and turned pale. Obachan noticed this and asked him if she was okay, and he would say that he had just remembered a strange dream. When Garmadon said the same, Wu wondered if it was the same dream he had, but Obachan interrupted the brothers. She and Hana then explained to them that many people had disappeared from the village and later returned as puppets who had kidnapped other people. Hana then asked the brothers if they would help them. Although Garmadon disagreed, Hana offered to pay them. But Wu stopped her and said they didn't have to give them anything because they would help them, because that's right. Garmadon, who disagreed, finally said they would help them, but only if Wu was the bait. Wu's stomach sank and asked what bait. Garmadon explained that he would be the bait in the puppet trap, which they would prepare the next night.[25]

The puppet trap[]

The next day, the brothers prepared the puppet trap according to Garmadon's plan. When night fell, Wu lay down on a cot in Obachan's flower garden, pretending to be asleep under the night sky. However, in order to tease Garmadon, he decided to add some dialogue to his performance. That's why he shouted out loud, how wonderful it is to sleep outside, where anyone could kidnap him if they wanted it. Since Garmadon was not very happy about this, he ordered him to be quiet and told him that he had been given a simple job. Wu then quietly asked what it's easy to be handled by a bunch of creepy puppets. Then they heard voices and so they were silent, though Wu quietly told Garmadon that he did not know that the puppets could talk. As the puppets walked around the garden, Garmadon picked up a pebble and tossed it at Wu's shoulder, telling him to say something. Wu whispered, that he thought Garmadon said him to be quiet, but eventually he started screaming how wonderful it is to sleep outside. When two puppet commanders entered the garden, followed by the other puppets, Wu was lying perfectly still with his eyes closed, pretending to be asleep. The puppets then surrounded Wu and tied him from head to toe before he realized the danger. The puppets caught him and began carrying him out of the garden while he screamed for help. Then they entered the woods while Garmadon followed them until they came to a large hole in the ground which the puppets entered with the tied Wu.[26]

They then crossed the tunnel and entered a room where a shadow figure stood, calling himself Tanabrax. He then praised the puppets for bringing one of the ninja. He then used the tools he carried to make a puppet that looked like a young ninja. Wu suddenly sprang out of the arms of the puppets, shedding the rope bound his arms. He then shouted at Tanabrax that the game was over and started to launch into a spin. However, Tanabrax took the medallion hung around his neck and pointed at Wu. The young ninja slowly stopped spinning and his eyes locked to the medallion. Then he went limp and a tendril of white energy streamed from Wu's mouth into the puppet Tanabrax held.[27]

The battle with Tanabrax[]

The next morning, as Garmadon, Hana and Moody broke into the lair of Tanabrax, Puppet Wu was waiting for them at the end of the tunnel. As soon as they got there, he stepped out of the shadows and launched into a Spinjitzu tornado.[28] He then collided into his brother, knocking him off his feet. Before Garmadon could react, Puppet Wu had picked him up by the ankles and flipped him over. When Garmadon stood up, Wu did a handspring flip, landed in front of Garmadon and spun around, pummeling his brother with spinning kicks. Garmadon tried to flip Wu, but his wooded wrist was too thin and the older brother lost his grip. Wu then did three backflips and charged Garmadon again. The older brother than scooped him up with both arms, but Wu chomped down on his wrist and Garmadon let go. Puppet Wu then attacked Garmadon again, but he kicked him away. Hana then noticed a wooden trunk near the wall of the lair and got an idea. Garmadon went to the trunk and shouted at his brother to come to him. Puppet Wu raced across the lair. When he got close to his brother, he jumped up and spun into a kick, but Garmadon swiftly moved left and Wu jumped right into the trunk. Garmadon then quickly closed it. Puppet Wu then began kicking the trunk from inside, but failed to get out.[29]

When Garmadon entered the room with the bodies after the fight, he found Wu there and tried to wake him, but the soulless body did not move.[29]

When Moody killed Tanabrax, Wu and the other puppets regained their consciousness. Wu immediately started screaming from the trunk to let him out. Garmadon ran to it, opened it, and Puppet Wu climbed out. He then began to explain to his brother that Tanabrax had turned him into a puppet, and Garmadon explained that it was over. Then Wu realized he didn't have his body and asked where it was and if it was okay. When Garmadon told him it was in another room, Wu hurried there, running on his tinny legs. This made Garmadon laugh, and he suggested to his brother that he keep this body and prepare a great ventriloquist act and become famous. Wu told him it wasn't funny and then he marched into the other room.[30]

When they got there, Wu remembered Tanabrax speaking the djinn language when he was putting Wu's soul into a puppet. So he asked Bunch and Moody if Tanabrax had a book. When Moody found him right and brought Tanabrax's book, Puppet Wu opened it and leafed through the pages of the book until he found what he was looking for. When Garmadon asked him if he was sure he would change everyone back, what Wu told him no, but what was the worst that could happen. Garmadon then took the medallion and told Wu to go to his body, which the younger brother had done. Garmadon then cast a spell and the souls returned to their bodies. Garmadon walked over to Wu and asked him how he felt, to which the younger ninja replied that he was stiff and hungry while he stretched. When Hana asked what they would do with the puppets, Garmadon suggested they leave them there, but he wanted to take Wu's puppet home. However, since he could not find her, he told Wu about it. Although the younger brother at first thought he was joking and told him that he was not in the mood to do so, when he noticed the serious look on his brother's face, he also started looking for a puppet. However, when they did not find it, they finally decided to leave the lair.[30]

When everyone left the lair, Wu and Garmadon rolled and big rock over the opening in the ground. They then returned to the village with the other villagers.[31]

When they got there, Hana and her brother Shin came to the brothers and thanked them for the rescue, while Hana said she did not know what she would have done without her brother. Garmadon replied her that he knows what she means. Wu's eyes then went wide and asked if he could hear his brother well, as he said something nice about him. However, then Wu's face got serious, realizing that something had to be done with the medallion, suggesting that it be returned to djinns. Garmadon laughed at the idea and said it might be Wu's worst idea ever, and that they should rather eat, sleep, pack up supplies and get back on the journey. Wu nodded, but still didn't know what to do with the medallion. Obachan then told them to follow her to the garden. When they got there, she told Wu to bring the flour crock from the kitchen and Wu quickly obeyed. When he returned, the old woman put a medallion in the jar and buried it in the ground. Wu asked nervously if it would be safe there, and Garmadon assured him it would. Obachan then suggested that they go eat some of Mrs. Uchida's dumplings. Wu looked at his brother and grinned, asking his brother if they could get dumplings now and the next day they would continue on their journey. As Garmadon agreed, they both followed Obachan so they could eat.[31]

After the journey[]

Years after Wu and Garmadon's journey, Dillon and Adara visited Wu in the Monastery of Spinjitzu and brought him Nineko's umbrella, which they found in the ravine. Wu decided to keep it as it reminded him of how close he came to losing his brother forever.[32]

Although the next part comes from a canonical book, this part is different from the flashbacks that were featured in Spinjitzu Brothers.

As part of Wu's and Garmadon's training, their father sent them into the world to survive the wonders of the realm he had created, to meet the humans who inhabited it, and to learn about the challenges to be faced in protecting Ninjago. Wu hoped that on this trip his closeness to his brother would be restored, as when they were younger. They therefore wrote down the places and tasks they would like to do on the trip, but despite the fact that they went on the same expedition, their journeys took them to different places. Their list included a trip to the Corridor of Elders, where they wanted to take their climbing equipment, climb to the Wailing Alps, where they wanted to enjoy the view and take their earplugs, go to "Cross-country racing with Treehorns" in Birchwood Forest, then want to go for a seafood dinner in Stiix, whose cuisine Wu loved, and finally for a trip to the Holy City of Domu, where their father recommended many good books from their library.[2]

Once during one fight, when Wu was young, he got a hiccup. However, he used it to his advantage, pretending one hiccup and together with it he inflicted an unexpected blow on his opponent.[2]

Death of the First Spinjitzu Master[]

When Wu and Garmadon were young men, their father had Wu and Garmadon vow to protect the Golden Weapons and then passed away.[33] Before he died, he told Wu he would leave him a message that would lead him to his final resting place. After he passed, Wu looked everywhere for it, not knowing it was on his father's staff all this time.[34] Wu and Garmadon would remain allies and a team against evil, such as Samukai, who they encountered and defeated.[35]

Wu learned of Nadakhan and his crew of Sky Pirates but did not encounter them himself, as he "was engaged in battles on the other side of the world" at the time.[36]

When Wu and Garmadon learned of a blacksmith who had absorbed the powers of the Elemental Masters, they sought him out in Metalonia and tried to stop him. The Master of Amber tried to use the Urn of Enmity to absorb their powers, but the urn sucked his spirit instead. The brothers thought it was a fitting punishment for him so they sealed the urn away in a tomb.[37]

Morro's training[]

Thousands of years after Aspheera's entombment, soon after his brother left to train under Master Chen, Wu found a young boy, Morro, rummaging through the monastery's trash cans in search of food. Wu took pity on him and trained him in the ways of the Ninja. He soon discovered that Morro was a descendant of the Elemental Master of Wind and believed him to be the Green Ninja. This ended up being his greatest regret as the thought of the power that came with the title made Morro incredibly arrogant and he flew into a fit of rage when the Golden Weapons did not react as they would when in the presence of the chosen one. Wu was disappointed, but still would not give him the Green Gi, as it was not his destiny. Wanting to prove his destiny wrong, Morro left vowing to find the tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master.[34]

Serpentine War[]

Shortly after Morro's departure, Wu and Garmadon met a young woman, Misako, whom they both fell in love with and wanted only the best for her. Wu even taught her Spinjitzu, and they got very close during their training.[2] In their duels, Wu never defeated Misako because both weren't really trying.[38] Later, Wu wrote Misako a heartfelt letter confessing his feelings, but it was intercepted by Garmadon's master, Chen, who convinced Garmadon to sign his own name to it in place of Wu's in order to win Misako's affections.

Shortly afterwards, the Serpentine War began. Wu and Garmadon decided to unite the Elemental Masters and formed the Elemental Alliance, which opposed Anacondrai in the battle of Birchwood forest. During the battle, Wu saw his brother facing off against a warrior named Mogra, who sided with the Serpentine in hopes of becoming a king, Wu ran into battle with the alliance and warriors behind him. Together, the two brothers defeated Mogra using spinjitzu, but shortly before Mogra was taken away and brought to his presumed execution, he warned them of the snake in their garden becoming a serpent.[39] Unfortunately, the alliance was able to defeat Mogra, but the battle at Birchwood forest was lost when the Master of Earth turned against the alliance after falling victim to the Hypnobrai's hypnosis.[40] Although they lost the battle, Garmadon got an idea and Sacred Flutes were created, with which the Serpentine were controlled and imprisoned in five separate tombs. The war ended and Wu, Garmadon and Mystake participated in the court of the Anacondrai generals as judges who banished Arcturus and other generals to the Cursed Realm.[41]

Battle for All Time[]

Shortly after congratulating the Elemental Alliance on their victory against the Anacondrai, the Elemental Masters of Time, twins Acronix and Krux, turned against them, believing that Ninjago should be ruled by the most powerful.[42] After the Elemental Masters were defeated by the Hands of Time, Wu came up with the idea to have the Masters of Fire and Water forged the Time Blades. When the weapons were done, he had the two rest as he and Garmadon donned the weapons and fought against the Time Twins.[43]

After a short battle, the sons of the First Spinjitzu Master defeated them, used the gauntlets to absorb their powers. Wu and Garmadon agreed that the element of Time was too powerful, and performed a ritual to open a Temporal vortex, to send the newly empowered Time Blades to be lost in time forever. Refusing to be defeated, the powerless Time Twins broke free of the Elemental Masters and into the Vortex. Within the Vortex, Wu saw a blimp that told him the exact time Acronix would eventually return to Ninjago—forty years in the future.[42] He kept this knowledge in mind, but thought Krux to be lost to time forever, unaware he would be released from the Vortex and know of his brother's return.[43]

Immediately after the Time Twins disappeared, the future Acronix and Krux appeared in a giant mech and an army of unfamiliar snake warriors. He, Garmadon, and the Elemental Alliance were no match for the Vermillion, but they were unknowingly assisted by the future children of Ray and Maya, Kai and Nya, pretending to be their parents. The Time Twins fled into time with the Iron Doom but were followed by "Ray" and "Maya's" Fusion Dragon. A mysterious individual riding the dragon, Wu's future self, tossed him the Reversal Time Blade. He gave it to Ray and Maya, who locked the Time Blade away in the Boiling Sea. Wu also heeded an instruction from his older self to obtain Obscuritea from Mystake, which erased his memories of the battle against the future versions of the Time Twins and the timeline of Ninjago was corrected.[44]

Lilly's training[]

Although the next part, according to the comic, takes place after Garmadon's banishment, in order to fit the continuity, it must take place before the banishment. See here for further explanation.

At some point after the Master of Earth of the Elemental Alliance transmitted his Earth power to his daughter Lilly, Wu took the girl under his tutelage to teach her to be a ninja and to master her elemental power. During their training Wu and Lilly notably meditated in the bamboo forest near the monastery, fought and trained in the monastery and Wu teach Lilly Spinjitzu. When Lilly left to complete dangerous missions, Wu always expected her to return.[45] When Lilly returned from the mission in Shintaro Mountain, Wu welcomed her and was happy with her return. The master of Earth also told her mentor that her powers were strongest when she was closest to the earth.[46] Shortly afterwards, he was present at the birth of Cole, who was to become his next student in the future.[45]

Battle Between Brothers[]

When Garmadon married Misako and eventually fathered Lloyd many years later, Wu was happy for his brother, but also somewhat melancholy due to the affection he still personally harbored for Misako.

Garmadon eventually succumbed to the darkness from the Devourer and his Oni heritage and planned to steal the Weapons. But when he tried, Wu confronted him. It was up to him to quench his brother's thirst to destroy. The brothers fought, and Wu won the battle, but at a cost. The kimono he was wearing had a protection spell to keep him safe from evil. This in turn worked on Garmadon, and cast Garmadon into the Underworld, banishing him for what could have been eternity.[47]

Peace returned to Ninjago, but knowing his brother's ambition to get all Four Weapons, he sealed each one away and placed a guardian to protect each individual one. He sealed the Sword of Fire in the Fire Temple, the Shurikens of Ice in the Ice Temple, the Nunchucks of Lightning in the Floating Ruins, and the Scythe of Quakes in the Caves of Despair in hopes of Garmadon never being able to find them. Fearing his own demise one day, Wu created a map of the weapon's location and entrusted it with his old friend, an honest blacksmith.[48]

The following information is considered non-canon.

At an unknown point in time, Wu visited a southern island known for its warm weather, only to find that everything had been frozen over with burning ice. He learned that a colony of Ice Ants from far up north had migrated beneath the island and had thus affected the environment, which returned to normal after Wu convinced the ants to go back to their original home.[49]

Non-canon information ends here.

Shortly afterwards, Wu's former student, Lilly, died, so Wu did not look for more students for a long time.[50] Over the following years, Wu stopped writing in his journal, he grew a long beard and studied a lot.[51]

Meeting the ninja[]

A few years before Garmadon's return, Wu went to look for Zane to become a ninja. When he came to the Birchwood Forest and met Dr. Julien, he learned that he was the second guest after a long time, as a stranger had visited them the day before, whom Wu had revealed to be the previous Elemental Master of Ice, and he guessed that he had donated his element to Zane. Dr. Julien then took him to his son. Zane asked Wu if he needed to chop wood. Wu tells him that some would say he has a knack at finding young talent and that he doesn't need to chop wood, at least not that day. Wu then realized that Zane was not ready yet and decided to wait a few years.[52]

Over the following years, Wu often visited his friends, Ray and Maya, and he befriended their children, Kai and Nya. He was looking forward to meeting them again in the future.[2]

A few decades later, Wu went to the clearings north of the Forest of Tranquility, where he collected a herb called Boscus Spiritum, from which special tea was made. Later he meditated, and Eventuali-Tea created from the herb revealed to him that his brother wanted to return from the Underworld. Wu also realized that it was becoming more and more difficult to take care of his father's legacy, so he decided to find four chosen ones who would take care of the Golden Weapons and oppose Garmadon. Wu therefore left the monastery and set out to find his new students.[2]

After years of searching, he looked for four young people he believed were destined to become the ninja who would protect the Golden Weapons. At first, Wu searched for Cole, and when he realized or sensed that Cole was a climber, he climbed a tall mountain and waited for him there.[2] When Cole climbed the same mountain and found him there, Wu asked him why he had climbed the mountain. Cole told him about his grief over the loss of his mother and that he was angry with his father for spending time with his group instead of grieving. Wu replied that "grief takes many shapes and forms". When Cole then asked him why he had climbed the mountain, Wu told him that he had climbed there to find him. Cole then decided to follow him and went to the monastery to become a ninja.[53]

Shortly after Wu recruited Cole, he went to Ninjago City and climbed to the roof of a tall building, where he drank tea and waited. Shortly afterwards, Jay landed on the same building, testing his glider. Although he wanted to give up and was angry, he was surprised to meet someone at the building and wanted to know more. Wu told him that "we are only confined by the walls we build ourselves". When Jay asks him who he is, he replied that he was a dreamer like Jay and he is attempting to build the impossible. Then he asked Jay if he would join him, and Jay agreed and went with him to the monastery.[54]

Shortly afterwards, Wu went again to find Zane, who was no longer in Birchwood Forest due to him losing his memories after his father died. Wu waited for him at the bottom of a frozen pond, where Zane tested his ability to hold his breath underwater, supported by villagers. He was very surprised when he met Wu underwater he drinking tea. Wu later asked him to join him and, like the others, took him to the monastery, where he began training them together.[55]

Pilot episodes

Pilot episodes[]

Way of the Ninja[]

Wu eventually returned to Ignacia in the hopes of convincing the blacksmith's son Kai to become the Master of Fire, and thus eventually the caretaker of the Sword of Fire. Upon arriving however he was disappointed that Four Weapons sold only tools for a samurai and voiced his complaints. In response, Wu was promptly ordered to leave by Kai.

Yet Wu didn't get far as the Skulkin Army soon attacked the blacksmith shop. Kai was quickly defeated by Samukai and Wu rushed in to save him, using Spinjitzu. The Skulkin General used his daggers to topple the nearby water tower as a distraction, and Wu hurried to save Kai from being crushed by it. Wu was alarmed to hear Samukai mention Garmadon as the Skulkin captured Nya, yet didn't have time to contemplate the matter as Kai attempted to go after them. Wu told Kai of the Golden Weapons and advised him to become a ninja in order to save his sister.

Master Wu took Kai to the Monastery of Spinjitzu atop the Mountain of a Million Steps where he gave the blacksmith one simple instruction; finish the training course before he finished his tea. However, Wu finished his drink even before the young blacksmith had a chance to start and told him to try again the next day, hoping to teach him patience. Kai eventually succeeded and Wu told him that a final test would come the next day.

The Golden Weapon[]

That night Jay, Cole, and Zane arrived at the monastery and attacked Kai. Wu eventually awoke and rushed out to the training yard to stop the fight. There he used Spinjitzu to give them their appropriate gis and announce their name and element. He then explained their mission before deciding that it was time to retrieve the first Golden Weapon.

To get there, Wu had the ninja pull him in a carriage as a team-building exercise. Upon arriving, Wu warned them not to use the scythe once they found it, and remained behind while the ninja infiltrated the skeleton's mines.

Yet Kai ignored Wu's warning and used the weapon in defense against the Earth Dragon, thus creating a large opening in the ground which the ninja used to escape. Wu chastised Kai for his actions and walked back to the carriage to go the next weapon.

King of Shadows[]

As the ninja sailed through the Frozen Wasteland, "drifting aimlessly for miles," Wu took a perch on the dragon sculpture at the front of the ship they were using. Wu unexpectedly turned around and informed the ninja about the Tornado of Creation, before the ship crashed into the Ice Temple. After they claimed the Shurikens of Ice, Wu sent the ninja alone to retrieve the Nunchucks of Lightning from the Floating Ruins while he prepared a camp in the Forest of Tranquility.

That night the ninja celebrated their success thus far, though Wu was hesitant as they had yet to claim the Sword of Fire. Nevertheless, Kai manages to convince him to show them some dance moves. Wu then sang and danced "Shake What Your Momma Gave You" before they all fell asleep.

Later that night, Kai was lured to the Fire Temple by Garmadon and Wu followed, arriving as his brother was using his shadow to defeat Kai. Wu used his own shadow to stop Garmadon and recovered the Sword of Fire, only to learn that the Skulkin had stolen the other three weapons. Kai, Wu, and Nya attempted to escape from the Temple to help the other ninja, but Garmadon awoke the Fire Dragon who quickly blocked their way out. Realizing the Skulkin were on their way to unite the weapons, Wu used the Sword of Fire to cut a rock free from the pool of lava, thereby sending himself into the Underworld with the Fire Sword to keep the weapons apart.

Weapons of Destiny[]

Upon arrival in the Underworld, Master Wu headed straight for Garmadon's Dark Fortress, where he confronted his brother in the throne room. He easily defeated the Skulkin soldiers sent after him, but soon faced a far greater challenge: Samukai, wielding the other three Golden Weapons. Master Wu fought hard, using the Sword of Fire to great effect, but Samukai's use of the other Golden Weapons overwhelmed him, leading to his defeat moments after the ninja broke into the fortress themselves.

As Master Wu recovered his wits, Samukai took the Sword of Fire and challenged Lord Garmadon for the throne of the Underworld. However, Garmadon simply laughed, revealing that the power of all four Golden Weapons was too much for anyone—even himself—to control, and Samukai was disintegrated as the weapons formed a portal. As Garmadon prepared to enter the portal, Master Wu tried to reach out to his brother, claiming that their father would not have wanted any of this to happen. His pleas were rebuffed by Garmadon, who revealed that his real plan was to trick Samukai into using all four Golden Weapons at once, thereby creating a portal to a realm where he could find the power to safely wield the powerful weapons himself. With that, Garmadon fled through the portal, leaving Master Wu and his pupils to gather the Golden Weapons and return to the mortal realm.

Mini-movies

Mini-movies[]

An Underworldly Takeover[]

Cole came to Wu, wondering how Garmadon took control of the Underworld. Wu assumed Garmadon and Samukai decided over a cup of tea.

Battle Between Brothers[]

When Zane commented on Wu's black kimono, Wu told Zane the story of how Garmadon was banished to the Underworld.

After mini-movies

After mini-movies[]

In order to train his ninja even better, Wu used the knowledge of himself and his father and improved them to suit his current students. While he was training them in the monastery and telling them "failed" when something didn't work out, he had to smile in his mind as he reminded himself of his father. During Zane's training with shurikens, he also lost three teapots, which Zane broke.[2]

Later, when he meditated he had a vision of several vehicles the ninja would use in the future. The first vehicle that appeared to him was the Destiny's Bounty, Captain Soto's old pirate ship, which Wu knew had wrecked on the Sea of Sand, and began wondering if it would be difficult to fix it so the ninja could use it if necessary. Second vehicle which appeared to him, the Desert Lightning , Jay's motorcycle, which Wu could imagine traversing any terrain, but he wasn't sure what the desert had to do with the vehicle. He thought Jay would find it there, or that he would build it there, but he finally realized that time would tell. Another Wu saw the Samurai Mech, who greatly outraged him, although he did not see who controlled it. He also saw the Ultra Sonic Raider, which the vision told him they would get under unexpected circumstances, and then the Titanium Ninja Tumbler, though Wu wasn't sure who the Titanium Ninja was, which drove the dark energy out of the vehicle. Then Jay Walker One appeared to him, and he saw an unknown scientist building it in a modern laboratory. He also saw the ghosts that this machine sucked. Then he saw the Boulder Blaster being assembled in the dark alleys of a mysterious place that Wu didn't recognize. Although he had no special relationship with the vehicles, he was sure that this vehicle would help the pilot escape from serious danger.[2]

The Spell at the Waterfall (flashback)[]

This part takes place sometime between the pilot episodes and the Final Battle, although the exact placement is unknown.

Wu travelled to the Dragon Stone Shrine and balanced on his staff there until he noticed a spell wandering there. He left his balanced position and demanded to know who was there, the spell apologized and was about to leave, catching Wu's attention, who excusing her and questioned the unchanged spell's existence, as seen had heard about its possility, but never saw one. The spell told him that she had been travelling the realms for centuries. Eventually, the two spent hours talking about their stories, during their talk, Wu identified the spell's feeling as loneliness, and began to the tell her about his brother, and the adventures they went together one their journey, but that they later broke off, causing Wu to feel lonely for many years, until he found students to teach, who later became his family, and that buildings friendships cured his loneliness.

The spell was astonished after hearing what Wu recommended to her. Wu suggested her to take on a physical form to interact with others, after the spell told him that she may use too much of her strength, Wu assured her that there are things more important than that. Wu supported Bonzle as she created her physical appearance.

Rise of the Snakes

Rise of the Snakes[]

Rise of the Snakes[]

Amidst Ninjago's era of peace, Master Wu often spent time meditating to spirit smoke in his quarters, though on one occasion he was interrupted by the sound of the ninja fighting. Curious he entered the training ground to find it deserted. He followed the cries of battle to the living room only to find the ninja playing video games. Angered at the sight, Wu unplugged the TV and expressed his dismay about them neglecting their training. As a response to their angered outbursts, he began to speak about the power of the Golden Weapons and how they had let to unlock their True Potentials. The ninja however ignored his warnings and returning to their video game, assuring their Master that they would be ready when Lord Garmadon returned. However, at the moment, Nya arrived and informed them that Garmadon had returned and was spotted approaching Jamanakai Village. Wu observed them rush to their dragons, displaying that they were not in peak shape. As they flew away, Nya approached him and ask if they would ever reach their true potential to which he replied that they would "in time."

Later in the day, Wu was disturbed from his meditation to find the ninja in the training course surrounded by flames. After using the Shurikens of Ice to extinguish the fire, Wu angrily demanded an explanation. The ninja revealed they had discovered the prophecy of the Green Ninja and had been holding a tournament to determine who it would be, though Wu informed them that none of them had achieved the skills for the title.

Wu returned to the spirit smoke and saw a vision of the Hypnobrai attacking Jamanakai Village. He quickly sent the ninja on ahead and by the time he arrived at the village, the Serpentine had retreated. Now realizing that a new threat was upon them, the ninja apologized for their lazy attitudes and implored their master to teach them the secrets of the Golden Weapons. Wu agreed and they returned to the Monastery.

Home[]

Once again, Master Wu's meditation was interrupted by his pupils' noise-making, but he was pleasantly surprised to find them in the training course rather than the game room. He dissuaded the ninja from questioning Zane's odd behavior and tried to comfort Zane when he became melancholy over not knowing his origins. Later, Master Wu ate dinner with his pupils and was dragged into a friendly food fight.

The next day, the ninja set out to Wildwood Forest on a tip from Zane, who had stumbled upon Lloyd's treehouse fortress after following a mysterious Falcon. Master Wu initially remained at the Monastery of Spinjitzu with Nya, but only so he could prepare himself for the battle against the Serpentine. He and Nya flew to the forest astride Flame's back, only to find the fortress crumbling and Cole attacking his allies (due to Skales' hypnotism). Recognizing the signs of Hypnobrai hypnosis, Master Wu played the Sacred Flute, breaking the spell and allowing the ninja to escape the fortress moments before it collapsed completely.

On their way back to the monastery, Master Wu explained the flute's significance to the ninja, claiming that it would play a large part in the defeat of the Hypnobrai. When Flame returned to the monastery, the group was horrified to see it destroyed—the Hypnobrai had burned it to the ground after retrieving their staff. As the ninja rushed to free the other dragons from their burning stable, they blamed Zane for their loss, prompting Master Wu to rebuke them for their rash anger. Before the ninja could apologize, Zane had already flown into the night on the back of his dragon.

Despite the loss of their home, Master Wu remained optimistic as he and his pupils erected a meager shelter from what they could salvage from the Monastery. The next day, Zane returned and explained that the Falcon had led him to a new home: the Destiny's Bounty. As the ninja rushed to explore the ship, Master Wu promised that they would help Zane find his family, only for Zane to reply that they were his family.

Snakebit[]

As the ninja worked on restoring the Destiny's Bounty, Jay's parents, Ed and Edna, came by to visit their son. Master Wu watched in amusement as Jay struggled to remain calm despite his parents' embarrassing antics; commenting afterward that the Blue Ninja could teach them all "the art of kissing pillows." The next day, he noticed that the ninja's dragons were molting, and told his pupils that the beasts would have to go to the Spirit Coves to complete their metamorphosis.

After seeing the dragons off, Master Wu joined the others in walking to Ed & Edna's Scrap N Junk so Jay could visit his parents. Upon arrival, they found the owners stuffed in a fridge, slowly transforming into snakes. Master Wu immediately realized that Ed and Edna had been bitten by the Fangpyre tribe, a suspicion confirmed when the Fangpyre revealed themselves, along with Lloyd (who had released them in hopes of getting revenge on the Hypnobrai who betrayed him).

The ninja immediately jumped into battle, fending off the snakes and their new vehicles while Master Wu began playing the Sacred Flute to weaken the Serpentine. Unfortunately for him, Lloyd drowned out the music with a Fangpyre-infected boombox; when Master Wu demanded that Lloyd stop that, his evil nephew simply turned up the volume and claimed not to hear his words. In the confusion, Master Wu was almost bitten by a Fangpyre Scout, but Edna knocked him out with a frying pan.

The Fangpyre were eventually forced to retreat, but their staff and its anti-venom was still in the hands of General Fangtom. To save Ed and Edna, Master Wu told the ninja about the Golden Weapons' ability to transform, and the ninja soon manifested vehicles of their own with which to pursue the fleeing Serpentine. Jay managed to retrieve the staff, but his inexperience with his new vehicle caused him to lose focus, reverting the jet to its original form. The other ninja soon followed, and the group barely escaped back to the Destiny's Bounty with the anti-venom.

Never Trust a Snake[]

One day, Master Wu discovered the ninja slacking off their duties to discuss a dream Zane had about the Green Ninja. As punishment, he made them train constantly until they could answer a riddle: "What is the best way to defeat an enemy?" Over the next few days, the ninja alternated between training and pondering the riddle, but nothing they thought of proved to be correct.

However, more pressing matters arose when Lloyd resurfaced with a new ally: Pythor P. Chumsworth, Serpentine General of the dreaded Anacondrai tribe. The villains took over Darkley's Boarding School for Bad Boys, forcing the ninja to head out—Master Wu and Nya followed in the Destiny's Bounty, arriving just in time to see Pythor betray Lloyd by stealing the Map of Dens and leaving him to be apprehended. Despite the ninja's demands that Lloyd is punished terribly, Master Wu insisted that he take care of his nephew, and proceeded to give him a home aboard the ship. He also read him a book called Jack the Rabbit. When the ninja protested, Wu revealed the answer to his unsolved riddle: "The best way to defeat an enemy...is to make him your friend."

Can of Worms[]

After Wu told Lloyd to prank the ninja and accuse each other, he taught them how rumors can cause trouble. When asked to go to the bridge, the ninja figured the locations of the Venomari and Constrictai tombs, and Wu sent them off.

After the ninja came back, they discovered the Serpentine are in the city and sent them off on another mission. He was later told that his students learned the power of rumors and used it to their advantage.

The Snake King[]

Wu hands the ninja their new gi and when the alarm sounds, he told Lloyd to stay on the Bounty while the ninja go on a mission to the Mega Monster Amusement Park. When he saw the ninja disappointed that the Samurai beat them to it, Wu taught them that "iron sharpens iron."

Tick Tock[]

The ninja realize they may have reached their full potential, and accidentally disturb Wu while he is packing. He tells them the story of how and why Garmadon was bitten by the Great Devourer and turned evil, before telling them they have completed their training. He then leaves for Mystake's tea shop for Traveler's Tea and uses it to travel into the alternate dimension Lord Garmadon had escaped into in search of his help in getting Lloyd back and defeating the Serpentine.

Once Bitten, Twice Shy[]

Garmadon confronts Wu and a battle ensues, with Garmadon summoning the mud monsters to consume Wu. Wu tells Garmadon that Lloyd is in danger, and Garmadon rescues Master just in time to prevent him from dying. They then journey to the Mountain of Madness.

The Royal Blacksmiths[]

Upon reaching the Mountain, Wu and Garmadon climb up, encountering the Craglings. They defeat the Craglings, and climb up to the top and escape through a vortex back to Ninjago.

The Green Ninja[]

Wu came back, and while Jay was excited to tell him what he missed, Garmadon appeared behind him. Wu told them he will be staying with them due to Lloyd being kidnapped by the Serpentine, much to their dismay.

Wu had Nya go in front of the Golden Weapons in hopes that it will react, but she refused. Eventually, Jay informed them that the Falcon spotted the Serpentine inside the Fire Temple, and they get ready to attack. Although, Kai thought Garmadon was stealing their Weapons, making the rest of the team to go after him. They were too late, however, and Wu told him off.

They fought the Serpentine, but the Temple was unstable; the Constrictai burrowed their way into the volcano to make it erupt. They were forced to leave without Kai and Lloyd, but after seeing Kai unlocked his True Potential, they realized Lloyd is the destined Green Ninja.

Prior to All of Nothing[]

After realizing that Lloyd would have to fight his father as the Green Ninja, Wu drew up a training plan for his nephew, helping Lloyd study books and scrolls every day at 1 p.m.[2]

All of Nothing[]

After the team decided to travel to the Serpentine's fortress, Wu was informed that Nya and Jay modified her Mech so that he could come along.

However, after a short fight, they were trapped in a Vengestone cage and had to wait for Lloyd to rescue them.

The Rise of the Great Devourer[]

Wu is meditating with the aid of his spirit smoke. The smoke shows him a vision of Pythor awakening the Great Devourer, causing Master Wu to come to a horrible realization. Later, as the Destiny's Bounty arrives over Torchfire Mountain, Wu tells the ninja that he "will not be able to see tomorrow" while the ninja proceed to set up a plank from where they can throw the Fangblades into the volcano. Unfortunately, Pythor chooses that moment to sabotage the engines, jerking the ship to one side and throwing Master Wu over the edge. The ninja form a human chain to catch their teacher. After Pythor got the four Fangblades, he alerts his minions to prepare for a fight and the Fangpyres use their venom to transform the bus into the Serpentine Train. Later, Master Wu leaps onto the front car and separates it from the rest of the train, declaring that battling Pythor is his destiny, while his students' destiny is to protect Lloyd. Master Wu fights Pythor but does not succeed to stop Pythor from releasing the Great Devourer. As Pythor tries to leave in fear, Wu holds him back, saying that he "must witness what he has created" and tells the ninja that it's his destiny and that they must do anything they can to stop the Great Devourer.

Day of the Great Devourer[]

Master Wu is consumed by the Devourer and is only seen at the end of the episode after Garmadon destroys the Great Devourer. He finds his tea kettle among what is left of the Devourer, commenting that it is still hot.

After Day of the Great Devourer[]

Wu was interviewed by Gayle Gossip and told her about how the Serpentine unleashed the Great Devourer to inform the citizens about the recent disaster.[56]

Tales from the Monastery of Spinjitzu

Tales from the Monastery of Spinjitzu[]

Blue Lightning (flashback)[]

This part takes place sometime during Rise of the Snakes, although the exact time is unknown.

While Jay was driving his Storm Glider over the Sea of Sand, Wu called Jay over the computer and alerted him that many Serpentine attacks had been reported and that Pythor had been reported at the teeth raiding a convoy of noodle trucks.

Dragons Rising, Season 1

Dragons Rising, Season 1[]

The Calm Inside (flashback)[]

This part takes place sometime after Rise of the Snakes or during Legacy of the Green Ninja, although the exact time is unknown.

Sometime during Lloyd's training, Wu took his nephew to the mountains where there was a storm. He wanted to train Lloyd by twisting the pendants on twines around him and for Lloyd to hit and destroy them. He told his nephew that he had to focus on each target separately, but Lloyd couldn't do it and began to despair and complain about the bad conditions in the storm. So Wu stopped twisting the pendants and walked closer to Lloyd to tell him that this was exactly the lesson he was trying to teach him. Since in real life the conditions for fighting are often unfavorable, it is necessary to find peace inside and the inner chaos will go away. Lloyd then tried hitting the targets one more time and finally succeeded, causing Wu to smile.

Legacy of the Green Ninja

Legacy of the Green Ninja[]

Darkness Shall Rise[]

Master Wu and Nya leave on a one-day road trip to get medicine for the Ultra Dragon and some other things and returns just in time to save Lloyd from Skales, who was plotting to kidnap him and convince Garmadon that he (Skales) should be in charge.

Pirates vs. Ninja[]

Wu observed Kai train Lloyd in their apartment, though when the ninja agreed that their conditions weren't suitable to properly train him, Wu sent them out into the city to find a better place.

Double Trouble[]

In Dareth's Dojo, Master Wu watched Jay train Lloyd to control his Lightning via light bulb. When the bulb breaks, Lloyd went to put his anger off on a punching bag. Wu told Jay to be patient. Just then, Nya entered to tell Jay if he wants to hang out with her at the Autobody shop and gave Wu a letter from Lloyd's old school. He read it and informed the team there's going to be a ceremony in honor of Lloyd reforming; they've been inspired to turn good.

Later, while cleaning up Lloyd's light bulbs, the "ninja" came back. He questioned if they had fun, with "Kai" replying he should come with them. Noticing they were wearing sunglasses and acting differently, Wu told "Kai" he shouldn't go to the Mega Monster Amusement Park because of his old age. When "Kai" agreed, Wu attacked the imposters, only to be pinned down to the wall by Bizarro Zane's shurikens. Bizarro Kai asks him where the ninja were, but was interrupted when Nya called on Jay's phone to meet her at the Autobody shop. As the evil ninja left, Wu was unable to warn the ninja about the clones.

Ninjaball Run[]

Wu had the whole team balance each other, with Lloyd at the bottom. When Jay questions this, he simply told them to find balance, they must trust each other. When a wrecking ball disrupted them, Dareth told the construction workers they were a day too early. Dareth informed them he doesn't have $50,000 to pay off his debts and that a company—Darnagom Enterprises—wants to tear the Dojo down. Figuring out Garmadon is behind this, Wu assures Dareth they'll come up with the money by the next day. Nya informed them about the Ninjaball Run Race, which will provide $100,000 as the grand prize—twice as much money than what they needed.

The next day, Wu sat with the audience to cheer on the ninja. When they won, he celebrated with the team.

Child's Play[]

Master Wu saw the ninja off on their mission to the Ninjago Museum of History, where Lord Garmadon was attempting to revive a Grundle. When the ninja did not return from their mission (due to being de-aged into children as a side-effect of Garmadon's spell), Master Wu joined Nya in searching for them. Their efforts proving fruitless, the duo returned to the Bounty, only to find a message from Lloyd, asking them to meet him and the ninja at the Ninjago Doomsday Comix Book store.

Putting some of the pieces together, Master Wu has Nya accompany him to Mystake's tea shop, where they request some Tomorrow's Tea. Due to Mystake having trouble finding the tea, Master Wu and Nya did not reach the comic book store until nightfall, finding the ninja at the mercy of the revived Grundal. After Lloyd uses the Tomorrow's Tea to restore the ninja and defeat the Grundal, Master Wu witnessed the Green Ninja aging into a teenager along with his friends.

Wrong Place, Wrong Time[]

As the ninja train Lloyd, Master Wu watches and comforted him when he regretted not taking training seriously before he aged. When Zane's Falcon showed a video of the Serpentine practicing for the Final Battle, the ninja went straight to Ouroboros. Once there, they snuck up on Garmadon and attacked. When he retreated, they followed him, only to find a portal created by the Mega Weapon leading to the past. Wu encouraged the ninja to go in after Garmadon and stop him from changing the past.

After Past Wu talked with Past Kai and Nya, the ninja went to inform him what's happening and asked for help, to which he accepted. When Samukai knocked down Past Kai, Wu used his Spinjitzu to attack the skeleton and save Kai, but Present Garmadon, disguised as a Skulkin, missed Nya on purpose. When Present Kai explained Nya was supposed to be kidnapped, he convinced Past Kai, and Nya, to become a Ninja. Back in the present, Wu watched as Lloyd vanished from a portrait.

At the monastery, Wu tried to make Kai train, but failed due to the latter's lack of motivation. When the ninja kidnapped Nya for the Skulkin, Past Wu then introduced Past Kai to the rest of the team. Present Wu watched Lloyd returned in the picture, but the city began to smoke up and Lloyd disappears once more, as Past and Present Garmadon made up a plan for the ninja.

In the Forest of Tranquility, Present Kai explained to the team what happened as they traversed to the Temple of Fire. After noticing Garmadon said something different than before, Present Garmadon appeared and started attacking Past Kai. After an intense battle, Wu watched as the ninja used the Past Golden Weapons against the Mega Weapon, erasing everything that already happened. In the present, Wu sat on top of the Bounty looking at Delta V.

The Stone Army[]

Wu and the ninja travel to the Museum after the Devourer's venom has made the Museum's gift shop bobbleheads come to life. One escapes, and Wu races after it, crushing it with his foot, only to turn around to find Misako, Lloyd's mother, greet him. When the giant Stone Warrior is unveiled, the Devourer's venom drips on it, bringing it to life. Wu and the other escape it for a short period while Lloyd works on a trap. Misako finds Lloyd, and Lloyd tricks the warrior into standing on top of paper covering up the bottomless pit it was found in. Wu invites Misako to join the ninja, and she says only if her son allows it. Lloyd allows her to, and she lives with the ninja from that point forward.

The Day Ninjago Stood Still[]

While the ninja train Lloyd, Wu takes his hat off to look at a photograph of him, Garmadon, and Misako. Misako unexpectedly appears behind him and startles Wu. Misako shows him her research and the scrolls containing the prophecy of the Green Ninja.

Moments later, while an earthquake shakes the Bounty, Misako suggests making the NGTV tower an evacuation station for the Bounty to land on. Wu and majority, if not, all, civilians left in the city, and the ninja climb up the stairwell.

Misako loses the container her research was in and goes back to get it. Once everyone (excluding Misako) is on board, the Stone Warriors start destroying the Bounty's engines, and Wu leaves at the last moment to save Misako as the Bounty flies off.

Misako gets to her research, but at a cost; she is now dangling off the side of a 20-story high stairwell. Wu fights his way through the Stone Army and gets to Misako at the last moment and saves her. They are only left with one choice after the Army backs them into a corner. Zane senses that Nya should fly the Bounty downwards, and orders her to do it. Wu and Misako jump off of the building, and land on, to their surprise, the Destiny's Bounty.

The Last Voyage[]

Wu informed Zane about the Island of Darkness and wondered if Garmadon and the Stone Army set up camp there. Zane then released the Falcon to see what's on the island. After the ninja failed to fix the Bounty, Wu told them they can't give up hope. Misako then told the ninja there's a way to defeat Garmadon; they have to find the Temple of Light to restore their powers. They then decided to sail instead of fly.

When Zane was the only one who didn't say goodbye to anyone, Wu tried to comfort him by saying there are some people who do want to say bye to him. They left Ninjago and watched what the Falcon has to offer, but it was attacked by a Stone Warrior. While they sailed, they went towards a storm, and the Bounty was attacked once more by Starteeth, which was too much to fend off.

The next morning, the ninja tried to rid the Bounty of water, and they crashed on Lighthouse Island. They went to check it out, but not before hearing a growl in the waters. Dr. Julien, surprised to find Zane, opens the door to let them in to explain everything. He then sat them down on a table while Tai-D served them tea.

Dr. Julien told them that after Zane left the hidden workshop, Samukai revived him to make him build vehicles for his army. A leviathan was chained down in the Ocean to prevent him from escaping.

After the Leviathan went to check the prison, Julien covered for them by using their cups as drums to pass the time. After it left, they made blueprints and Wu went down to help everyone fix the Bounty. When night falls, the leviathan showed up once more and grabbed the newly-fixed Bounty with everyone in it. Wu instructed Lloyd to use his Energy, but it didn't do anything. Zane went down to release the leviathan using Starteeth, and they were finally freed. They then continued their journey to the Dark Island with Dr. Julien as their new ally.

Island of Darkness[]

When Master Wu sleeps in Destiny's Bounty, Celestial Clock appears to him. He then wakes up.

Later, Wu sends the ninja out to find the Temple of Light while he, Dr. Julien, Misako, and Lloyd stay back to work on vehicles for the ninja. They complete the vehicles, (the Earth Driller and the Fire Mech) before sending out the ninja to the Temple. When Lloyd uses the "Golden Dragon," Wu, Misako, Nya, and Julien are watching inside the Bounty, and Wu is embraced by Misako.

The Last Hope[]

When he found the ninja using their Elemental Powers, he told them to stop, as it might reveal their hiding place. He then comforted Lloyd when he told Wu that he's afraid of facing his father. He later told Lloyd to let the ninja help Misako infiltrate Garmadon's camp, as it might start the Final Battle early.

He met up with the others at the clock. When they didn't put the helmet on the perch on time, they fell down the cliff, landing in the Endless Sea as Nya gets captured by the Army.

Return of the Overlord[]

After encouraging Lloyd to face his father, the team went to the Stone Army base but found it was empty. They followed tracks left by Garmatron to make sure they don't use the weapon on Ninjago. However, Dr. Julien went back to the Bounty.

On the way, they encountered Nya, who is corrupted by Dark Matter. The ninja stayed behind to take care of her while Lloyd, Wu, and Misako continued their journey and fought the Army.

In the midst of the battle, the ninja and Dr. Julien came back to help. However, the Stone Army went back to ninjago via a portal. With the Bounty destroyed, they are stuck on the Dark Island.

Rise of the Spinjitzu Master[]

Wu surprised the ninja when he told them he has no words of motivation. After Lloyd pep talked to them, they followed the Falcon and found the Golden Mech. With the Ultra Dragon's help, they're able to travel back to Ninjago.

Wu and the ninja decided to go on the Dragon to divert the Army's attention toward them instead of Lloyd. When Lloyd defeated the Overlord, Wu and Misako went to greet Garmadon, now purified of the Devourer's venom.

After the Final Battle

After the Final Battle[]

After the Overlord was defeated, Wu acquired Darkley's Boarding School and turned it into "Wu's Academy", of which he became headmaster and the ninja (along with Nya and Dareth) became teachers.

Rebooted

Rebooted[]

The Surge[]

Wu takes his students and the ninja to New Ninjago City where he, Nya, and the students are escorted around Borg Tower by P.I.X.A.L. while the ninja speak to Cyrus Borg. However, the tour goes awry when the Digital Overlord takes over the systems, turning the machinery against the tour group. They manage to make it out of the building only to find the city under attack by its security systems. Wu and the ninja get the civilians to safety, though are easily outmatched by the Security Mechs.

The Art of the Silent Fist[]

Wu is taken back to Borg Tower where the Overlord probes his memory to find where the ninja are hiding. Once the Overlord discovers the ninja's location, he assimilates Wu into a drone, similar to what he did to Cyrus Borg.

Blackout[]

Pythor breaks into Borg Tower where he takes both the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and Wu to a location in the sewers where he uses the Electrocobrais to power them both. He then sends the now Techno Wu to Ed & Edna's Scrap N Junk where they attack the ninja.

The Curse of the Golden Master[]

Techno Wu is sent along with a host of Nindroids by the Overlord to Hiroshi's Labyrinth to capture Lloyd, whom they find at the heart of the maze. While Lloyd escapes, Techno Wu battles Garmadon once again. Wu is eventually victorious and captures Garmadon, taking him aboard the Nindroid MechDragon.

Enter the Digiverse[]

Techno Wu, Pythor, General Cryptor, and the Nindroids break into Borg Tower to stop the ninja from erasing the Digital Overlord. Techno Wu and the Nindroids break down the lockdown walls in Borg Tower and break in through the savages.

Techno Wu is later seen battling a Nindroid, who lifts his hood to be Master Garmadon. Wu is victorious, but when the Overlord is wiped, he is turned back into Master Wu and helps save his brother.

Codename: Arcturus[]

Wu and Garmadon are at the Temple of Light to restore Lloyd's golden power and the ninja's elemental powers. Garmadon thinks it is a waste of time because they need balance, but Wu tells him it was Lloyd's idea, not his.

Wu spots Cryptor and Pythor on a satellite and sends Kai after them, but Kai becomes careless and is taken prisoner by Pythor.

Later, at Borg Tower, Garmadon tells that they defeated Arcturus, an ancient Serpentine General when they were first on each other's side. Wu asks where the Serpentine did their stargazing, and Zane jumps to the answer: The Lost City of Ouroboros.

The Void[]

Wu returned to Borg Tower with Nya, Garmadon, and P.I.X.A.L. where they were able to contact the ninja. Advising them that if they "couldn't change their circumstances, they should change themselves," they were able to provide the ninja help in their attempt to take over the comet-bound ship. However, their communications were discovered by Pythor who led a squad of Nindroids to attack Borg Industries.

The four managed to escape to Garmadon's monastery and they re-established contact with the ninja.

The Titanium Ninja[]

Wu encourages the ninja to find a way to get back to Ninjago. They eventually reached the Temple of Fortitude, where Cyrus gave them a shrinking pill.

There, Wu and Garmadon formulate a plan: Using their strategy when they played Templegate Tigers to "thread the needle" and hit the pill straight into the Overlord's mouth.

With Garmadon's help, they did so but was disappointed when Pythor took the pill instead. The Golden Master captured all but Zane, who sacrificed himself to save Ninjago.

Prior to Tournament of Elements

Prior to Tournament of Elements[]

After Zane's apparent death, the ninja disbanded and Wu and Lloyd began living with his brother and Misako in Garmadon's monastery.

Tournament of Elements

Tournament of Elements[]

The Invitation[]

Following Zane's memorial, Master Wu requested the remaining four ninja to train at Borg Industries, but only Lloyd came. Upon asking his nephew where the others were, he said the loss of Zane would affect them all and that it would either bring the team together or tear them apart. Wu later appeared at Garmadon's monastery looking at the plans for Destiny's Bounty.

Versus[]

While helping Nya rebuild the Bounty, he fell asleep from listening to her talk about her problems with Jay and Cole. When Nya asked for some advice on the situation, Wu stated he was staying out of it. He then questioned Misako about contacting Garmadon and the ninja and when she responded she hadn't, he decided to "expand their horizons," to which Nya set off in their backup vehicle the D.B. Express.

Ninja Roll[]

Wu communicated with Nya as a hologram, asking where the noodle trucks go during the night. By asking where they were going, he implied to investigate further into the subject.

Spy for a Spy[]

He was mentioned by Dareth, who contacted him from the D.B. Express on Chen's Island.

Spellbound[]

While Misako attempted to contact Dareth and Nya using the computer in the Samurai X Cave, Wu made a pot of tea and offered some to her. In response, she berated him for being so calm when they didn't know where everyone was. Wu assured that he too was concerned, but had faith in Garmadon to guide them.

The Day of the Dragon[]

Wu and Misako contact Nya getting an update of Chen's plans and states they will pick up the ninja and their allies on the Bounty.

The Greatest Fear of All[]

The ninja return to Ninjago on Elemental Dragons and see Chen hasn't attack yet before heading off for the Samurai X cave. Wu is reunited with Zane complimenting his new form. He is thanked by Garmadon for looking after Misako while he was gone. The group soon wonders on what to do about Chen and his army as Garmadon states if Chen's invades war will break out and their worst fear would emerge as Wu states "The greatest victory would be that has no battle" and after Falcon gives them a clue they travel to Kryptarium Prison and meet Pythor. Initially, he wants nothing to do with them for all the pain they put him through until seeing Garmadon's new Anacondrai form which changes his mind.

The prison soon comes under attack by Anacondrai warriors as the ninja go off to fight them Wu and the others stay behind. When Zane notices Pythor's venom falling on Garmadon's hand, transforming it, he deduces that's why they came for Pythor as he holds the key to making the transformation permanent. Wu then realizes that was why Chen hadn't attack yet and agrees with Lloyd on keeping him away from the cultists. Wu has Zane join the other ninja in keeping the Cultists at bay while he, Garmadon and Lloyd make off with Pythor just as the prison is put on lockdown. As the group of four runs away, Pythor admonishes them for their cowardice as Wu retorts back and mentions the Serpentine War and Pythor states Chen informs them that the humans would betray the treaty as Garmadon states Chen said the same about the Anacondrai before Lloyd realizes Chen tricked both sides into war.
