Misako, Clutch Powers with his interns and Wu explored the jungle on the island. They were cutting through the jungle since morning when they encountered a statue that Wu recognized as a totem pole. They thought it is just an ordinary statue, though their hopes were vanished when the Stone Golems attacked them.

The expedition was defeated by the golems who worked with the Keepers, and since they thought they had come to steal the Storm Amulet like everyone else, they imprisoned them in their village.

The Gift of Jay[]

When Lloyd broke into the prison to save the expedition and the ninja, he found that everyone were fine but did not know where Jay was. When they escaped from the prison, Clutch Powers and Dwayne tried to steal the Storm Amulet, but everyone were stunned during the attempt. They woke up on the coast of the island, where they were all tied to wooden poles. When Chief Mammatus was talking about how the First Spinjitzu Master giving them Storm Amulet to guard it, Wu gasped as he mentions him.

The Tooth of Wojira[]

When Jay was apparently kidnapped by Wojira, Kai managed to burn the rope that tied him to the pole and then freed the other ninja and Wu. When Wu freed Misako, they were attacked by a Rumble Keeper, but Wu easily defeated him with Spinjitzu. While the ninja tried to save Jay, Misako and Wu were recaptured by the Keepers again. When Wojira was discovered as a fake ship built by Ronin, who was imprisoned along with his henchmen, Wu, along with the ninja and the expedition, took part in thanking Mammatus, only to found out that Clutch stole the Storm Amulet. However, he was stopped by Nya. When Lloyd pondered in the docks whether there was a real Wojira, Misako and Wu came to see him, and when Lloyd then asked them about it, Wu told him that even if a real monster existed, she could sleep for another thousand years.

Prior to The Virtues of Spinjitzu

Prior to The Virtues of Spinjitzu[]

Shortly after the conflict on the uncharted island, the ninja, Misako and Wu decided to return home to the Monastery of Spinjitzu.

The Virtues of Spinjitzu

The Virtues of Spinjitzu[]

While the other ninja were in the Monastery of Spinjitzu, Wu ordered Kai and Jay to go to the courtyard and meditate on the six fundamental Virtues of Spinjitzu.

Curiosity[]

As Kai and Jay competed over who would break more bricks, Wu heard a rumble and went out of the monastery into the courtyard angrily. When he noticed that the whole courtyard was dirty from broken bricks, he asked them where they had taken them, and when they showed him the broken monastery wall, he became even more angry. When the other ninja came to the courtyard and wondered what had happened, Wu explained that instead of meditating on the Virtues of Spinjitzu, Kai and Jay had destroyed the monastery wall. When Jay didn't understand what he meant by these virtues, Wu told him not to tell him he had forgotten. When Kai pretended to know what their master was talking about, Wu asked him to appoint him the virtues. However, as he did not know, Wu turned to Nya and asked her, but she did not know the answer either. The master then asked if anyone at least remembered what he had talked about before, and when even Zane didn't know, he got angry and ordered them to settle in a meditation position on the courtyard.

After a while, Wu appointed them all the six Virtues of Spinjitzu while circling them from outside the circle. He said the first virtue to Nya, Curiosity. Then he dropped the brick on which Cole was sitting and told him the second virtue, Balance. Then he turned the meditating Lloyd on the other side to face the circle and said the third virtue, Wisdom. As Jay tried to eat the cookie, Wu knocked it out by his bo staff and said the fourth virtue, Honesty. When Zane caught a cookie, he said to the fifth virtue, Generosity, and when Zane handed the cookie to Kai and he was about to eat what Wu had prevented him from, he said the last virtue, Courage. He then explained to them that the Virtues of Spinjitzu are the qualities of which the true ninja is forged.

When someone knocked on the monastery gate, Wu went to open it, but did not return. When Nya came to the gate and opened it, the ninja noticed a large green dragon holding a screaming Wu in his paws. As the dragon flew through the monastery on its tower during a fight with the ninja, Wu tried to squeeze out the dragon paw, but failed. Wu then used his Elemental Essence of Creation to create a portal without the ninja knowing about it. The dragon then flew inside with Master Wu and the ninja followed them.

Balance[]

Still being held by the green dragon, Wu tried to escape its grasp, but was unable to free himself as the dragon jumped into another portal.

Wisdom[]

After the dragon flew into the portal with Wu in his paw, they both found themselves on the Speedway Five-Billion in Prime Empire, although they quickly left the game by the another portal at the finish line of the race while Wu was screaming.

Generosity[]

Wu screamed as the Legendary Dragon flew into the next portal in the Mines of Shintaro.

Courage[]

When the ninja reached the final challenge on the Island of the Keepers, they noticed Master Wu, who was still trapped in the dragon's paw and screaming. As Kai entered the force field, the Legendary Dragon threw Wu to the ground where he stayed. During the dragon battle with the ninja, the green dragon spewed a green fire at the lying Master Wu, but Kai quickly jumped in front of him and used his Fire to protect him.

When the ninja defeated all the dragons and destroyed the Legendary Dragon, Lloyd found it bizarre. Wu put on his hat then and said that maybe Lloyd was right, but it was also courageous and he pointed at Kai. When Cole asked him if he was okay and didn't hurt himself, he started stroking his long beard and smiling suspiciously at what Nya noticed and said that something seemed wrong. Wu told her that she was very observant and that something like that would come from a curious mind. Lloyd then realized that all the challenges were designed to teach them the six fundamental virtues of Spinjitzu, which Wu confirmed and praised him for a wise discovery.

Wu then used the power of Creation to end the illusion he had previously created, and they all reappeared in the monastery where they sat as before, with Wu standing in front of them, holding his bo staff. He first pointed at Nya with the staff and praised her for her curiosity, which led her to discover the dragon that had taken him. He then started walking from the outside of the circle again along the ninja and told Cole that it was his balance that allowed him to traverse the lava room in the pyramid. Then he walked over to Lloyd and grabbed his shoulder, telling him that it was his wisdom that helped him cross the finish line. He then pointed to the staff at Jay and said that honesty was key to his victory in the ice arena and then went to Zane and told him that through generosity, he achieved his goals. Finally, he poked the staff on Kai's stomach and said that his courage empowered him to conquer the final challenge. When Lloyd then asked him if it wasn't real, Wu told him that reality was all in one's perception, looking at the roof of the monastery, where were all the three dragons Wu was winking at.

Seabound

Seabound[]

A Big Splash[]

When the ninja returned from the mission, they met Wu in the hangar bay. He asked them what was in the henchmen-controlled trucks. When he learned that they had Vengestone there, he realized that it has few practical uses. However, if he wanted to know more about Miss Demeanor, who led the group, the ninja told him about the unexpected complications caused by Nya.

Eventually, they decide to found out more at the library. Eventually, among the scrolls, Wu found what he was looking for, but there was no mention of Water or Wind in a scroll that showed a complete list of the Elemental Powers. Wu then told them that his father had told him an old fairy tale about how he controlled all the Elemental Powers except Wind and Water because they belonged to someone else, Wojira. He told them that Wojira was able to create a destructive storm if she used her elements. However, the First Spinjitzu Master stopped her with the help of the Merlopians, a sea folk who lived long before the creation of Ninjago. Wu then took a magnifying glass and attached it to his eye. With that, he viewed the scroll that depicted the Battle of Nine Days, telling the ninja that Wojira was defeated by a Merlopian warrior by prying two amulets that allowed her to control two forces that affected the Endless Sea. When Jay asked Wu if Nya's powers were conntected with Wojira or her amulets, Wu replied that he didn't know. Therefore, he convinced Kai to call his mother Maya, thinking that she could help Nya with the problem.

Later, as Nya walked around the courtyard, Wu told her that he needs to talk to her. However, he was interrupted by knocking on the gate of the monastery, as his parents Kai and Nya have already arrived.

Prior to The Call of the Deep[]

After Ray and Maya arrived, Wu went to the library, where he searched books and scrolls with Misako for information about the Elemental Power of Water.

The Call of the Deep[]

When Nya, who is not happy with her mother's care, came to the library, Wu and Misako searched the books. Nya asked them if they have found anything, but Wu told her that there is very little mention of water in the books. He argued that Maya might be the answer. Nya continued to complain, but he advised her to talk to her brother.

Later, when an energy wave spilled water in the relaxation room, the ninja had to clean it up. Wu therefore used a mop to wash the floor. When Zane and P.I.X.A.L. entered the room and informed them that the energy waves had come from the Tartarus Trench, Wu asked P.I.X.A.L. if she built a submersible a few years ago, and when she said yes, the master informed the ninja that they must go diving.

Unsinkable[]

When the ninja and P.I.X.A.L. decided to use the Hydro Bounty, they went with Wu to the harbor. When P.I.X.A.L. introduced the submarine, Wu praised it. Then Nya doubted whether to go to the Tartarus Trench, but Wu asked her if she would rather stay with her mother, because he knowed it would convince her. When his plan came out, he turned around and chuckled.

Riddle of the Sphinx[]

While the other ninja were on a mission in the Endless Sea, Wu persuaded Ray and Kai to take part in his small research project to study the effect of elemental powers on a former master. He jumped on the golden dragon statue in the middle of the monastery's courtyard, from where he watched them. However, when Ray and Kai did only sparring, Wu told Kai to use his Elemental Power of Fire. When Kai listened to him and Ray screamed, Wu chuckled. At that moment, Cole who called with the others run out from the monastery and explained to Wu, Ray, and Kai that the Storm Amulet was in the Explorer's Club.

Wu, Ray, Kai and Cole then went to the club with Misako. All five at once burst into the club and asked if they could go to the archives to get an amulet. When Cecil Putnam didn't want to let them down, Wu told him it was an emergency and that Clutch Powers had a dangerous artifact. Then Cecil replied that they had a good number of very dangerous artifacts in this establishment. When Wu asked him if he was okay with it, he approached him and told him that the members of the Explorers Club laughed in the face of danger. Misako then realized that the only way to get inside was Trial By Sphinx. Then Cecil pushed the button and the Sphinx shot out of the floor, telling its riddle. When Wu wanted to say the answer, Cole overtook him and said the wrong answer, cake. Wu therefore said a second attempt, discipline, because according to him discipline is usually the answer to everything. However, the answer was still incorrect until Kai answered correctly, when Cecil let them in.

They then burst into the room where Clutch Powers was talking about his fictional adventure. They demanded a Storm Amulet from him. At the same time, Kalmaar and the Maaray Guards burst into the room. Clutch frightened them, threw the amulet into Wu's hands, and ran away. When Kalmaar challenged the master to hand him the amulet but he replied that he should get it himself and prepare for fight. Wu twisted the staff in his hand several times and prepared to fight. He then hit Kalmaar in the face and twisted the staff again. Kalmaar tried to take the Amulet from him, but Wu defended himself with the staff. When they fought again, Wu defended himself with an attacked by the staff. Kalmaar wraped his tentacle around the staff and threw Wu to the other side of the room, knocking the master's staff out of his hands. However, Wu did not give up and stood on the corner of the staff lying on the ground, which jumped right into his hands. He then told Kalmaar that his invasion would be short lived because the ninja would return. The two then run towards each other and collide.

Papergirl[]

After the explosion at the Explorers Club, Kalmaar managed to get the Storm Amulet and left the building. However, he was immediately attacked by Kai and Wu, who ran out of the building, kicked him and threw him to the ground. When Kalmaar fired by the trident at Cole, Wu jumped in front of him and covered the attack with staff, but fell to the ground. When he was attacked by the other Merlopians, he stood up and fought.

Later, when Antonia and Nelson managed to save Kai, Wu with Ray and Cole ran up to them. Wu asked what had happened and thanked them for doing everything they could. Wu then urged the others to hurry, as they could still catch Kalmaar. They therefore ran to the harbor.

Master of the Sea[]

When Kalmaar came to the harbor and imagined the destruction of Ninjago City, Wu ran up to him along the pier and kicked him in the chest. When several Merlopians ran to Wu, Kai came to his aid. When Wu shouted at Kalmaar that he would not leave with the amulet, Kalmaar made fun of him and pretended to leave slowly. When Misako attacked him, Kalmaar brandished his trident and aimed it at Misako in a threatening manner. However, when Wu intervened, Kalmaar redirected his aggression towards Wu and fired his weapon, striking him. As the Merlopians threatened Kai, Cole, Ray, and Kalmaar having Misako hostage, Wu threw his staff to the ground and surrendered.

All five of them were then tied with a rope to the anchor so that Merlopians could drown them. When Gripe tossed the anchor into the sea, they sank with it. In a moment, however, they surfaced and gasped as they stood on the Hydro Bounty. When Jay untied them, Zane threw the staff at Wu. Wu then twisted it over in his hand and attacked the Merlopians. When Nya emerged from the water and obtained the amulet, Wu took it in his hands.

Later, when they returned to the monastery, Nya talked to Wu and the others about whether Benthomaar could stay with them for at least a while, and they agreed.

The Calm Before the Storm[]

When Nya and Jay were dancing Dancy Pants at Benny's Arcade Emporium, Wu called them and told them they were waiting for them at the Ninjago City Police Station.

Later, Wu, Benthomaar, Zane, Nya and Jay went with the Police Commissioner to see Glutinous. When the Commissioner roughly told them what the Merlopian wanted, Wu thanked him and entered the room with the others. When Glutinous told them that Wojira had awoken and Kalmaar was heading to Ninjago City, Wu realized that they did not have time, so he called P.I.X.A.L. and asked her if the new vehicles were ready. He then ran out of the room with the others.

Assault on Ninjago City[]

When Wojira and Kalmaar appeared near Gayle Gossip and Vinny Folson in Ninjago City, the Destiny's Bounty flew from behind a nearby building, on which Wu was standing, shouting at them to follow him.

Later, when two children were sailing in the water in the city in a tub, Wu dropped a rope from the Bounty so they could climb up. He then told them to go hide behind P.I.X.A.L., who was steering the ship. When Wojira watched them, Wu shouted at P.I.X.A.L. to hurry. However, Wojira managed to destroy the engines of the Bounty, which collapsed to the sea level, which flooded the city. When Wu and the children had come to terms with their demise, they were saved from Wojira by Kai and Zane, who dispersed her.

Nyad[]

While Nya fought Kalmaar and Wojira in Ninjago City, people on the Destiny's Bounty tried to get away from the flooded city. Wu called with the ninja to regroup, as Nya will not go to hold off Wojira for much longer. However, when Kai told him that the ninja never quits, Wu replied that the wise ninja knew when to retreat. The ninja therefore obeyed him and withdrew. However, as the Bounty failed to get out of the city on time, Wu got the idea and told P.I.X.A.L. to set a course for the NGTV building. Everyone who was on the ship then got out and went to hide in the building while leaving the Bounty at sea as bait for Kalmaar and Wojira.

As Benthomaar brought the wounded Jay to the building, Wu ran out toward them. He then urged them to take Jay inside and hide the vehicles so that Kalmaar would not find them. When Wu noticed Wojira not far from them, he quickly entered the building. They then talked about how Jay could be saved and later fell asleep.

As Nya rescued Jay and merged with the sea, Wu and the others woke up. Wu then asked Bentho what Nya was doing, and when he learned that she was trying to merge with the Endless Sea, Wu decided they had to stop her. They then ran to the roof and Wu shouted at Nya to come back, but to no avail. Then they decided to go help her.

The Turn of the Tide[]

While Kalmaar unsuccessfully attacked Nya, Wu and the ninja threw hooks at the Ninjago City Police Station and climbed the ropes to the roof. When Wojira fired the Fury of the Storm at the building, Jay and Wu fell to the ground. Jay then took Wu's staff and attacked the serpent. When the ninja and Wu were attacked by the Merlopians, he obtained a trident from the defeated warrior and disarmed several Merlopians. Then he used Spinjitzu for another attack. Later, when Kalmaar was eaten by Wojira, Nya turned into a dragon while the others watched her fight with the serpent. When Wojira almost killed the ninja and Wu, they were saved by Nya, who destroyed the Wave Amulet and defeated Wojira.

Nya then jumped on the building where they were standing and was about to go to the sea. Wu shouted at her to fight it, remembering who she was, but unsuccessfully as Nya jumped into the sea and left.

Later, when everyone who wanted to say goodbye to Nya at her memorial came to the monastery, Wu stood behind the urn in the middle, saying his speech and that wherever Nya was, she remained in their hearts forever.

After Seabound

After Seabound[]

Tentacles Below![]

A couple of days after the Great Flood, Wu was talking with Misako at the Monastery shortly before Lloyd arrived and told them about the reapirs in Ninjago City and the lack of fish supply which was currently being fixed. P.I.X.A.L. then informed them that there was a sea monster in the city's sewer system that was causing chaos. The ninja went to the city while Wu and Misako stayed at the monastery.

Back to Merlopia![]

In the monastery, during the break of a training session, Glutinous arrived from Merlopia and told the ninja and Wu that due to Benthomaar's absence in a quest to find a Water Dragon, Gripe and some other renegade Maaray Guards found a perfect opportunity to conquer Merlopia, the ninja and Glutinous immediately after went back to Merlopia to stop Gripe's plan.

Great Droids Think Alike[]

After Nya's memorial, Wu spent most of his time in the library trying to find a way to turn Nya back into a human by searching scrolls regarding the Elemental Power of Water with Misako, but without success.

Bad Water![]

Wu made some tea for Misako, but after taking a sip, Misako spit the tea and told Wu that it tasted like boiled rubber right before the ninja told them about the bad water in the shower. Zane later realized that the water was filled with chemicals so the ninja went to the city. Wu was later warned by Zane not to drink any water.

At some point after the Great Flood, Wu helped a grieving Kai by having him practise his form to calm him down.[64]

After many months of searching through many scrolls, Misako decided to go to the Library of Domu, Wu refused to go with her and preferred to stay in search of his own collection.

Crystalized

Crystalized[]

Farewell the Sea[]

Exactly a year after Nya's memorial, Wu was still searching the scrolls in the library, thinking he might find something in the Scrolls of Quanish the Elder. When Cole entered the room, Wu was upset that he had found nothing. Then he thought that maybe he should go to the Library of Domu with Misako, as they have a larger collection. Cole then told the Master that he thought they should put the team back together as someone was gathering Vengestone. Wu then finally stood up, took his staff, and agreed with Cole about bringing the team back together, as Vengestone's only practical purpose was to negate Elemental Power.

The Shape of Nya[]

Some time later, when the ninja met in the hangar bay and Kai and Jay started fighting, Wu heard some noises and went downstairs to find out what was going on. But then Nya came from the water and told them that they have to drain her powers away to turn her into a human. When Lloyd realized that the only possible way was Aspheera's magic, Wu told them there must be another option, as Aspheera could not be trusted. However, the ninja outvoted him and decided to free the sorceress, with which Wu disagreed at all and left the hangar bay indignantly.

A Mayor Problem[]

When the ninja returned from the Mayor's Office, they gathered in the hangar bay. Lloyd told them they had to get Aspheera out of prison illegally, which Wu objected, saying this was not the way to turn Nya back, but Lloyd ignored his opinion. Lloyd then asked the others if they agreed with a plan to free Aspheera. Everyone agreed, except for Wu, who apologized to them that he could not be a part of it, as Aspheera could not be trusted. Then he turned and left the hangar bay.

Public Enemies 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5![]

When the ninja returned to the monastery with Aspheera, Wu was already waiting for them right outside the monastery door. The sorceress opened the door just to face Wu's suspicious face. Aspheera said she had always dreamed of changing their roles, which Wu replied that if it was up to him, he would never let her go out of Kryptarium Prison. But then he said that their destinies were now linked and that he would not stand in her way to freedom if she turned Nya back.

Wu and the ninja then took Aspheera to the hangar bay, where they showed her the frozen Nya. Wu explained to Aspheera that she could change her back by draining her powers away, as she had done with Kai. However, Aspheera explained to them that she needed her staff for it, so the ninja had to leave to get it.

A Painful Promise[]

After the ninja went to get the staff and left Skylor in the hangar bay to keep Nya frozen, Wu watched her. When Skylor explained that she would not keep Nya very long, Wu began to fear that they would lose Nya forever. That's when he noticed that Aspheera had disappeared. He immediately started looking for her in the hangar until he found her standing in front of the Golden Weapons and immediately stopped her before she could touch them. Aspheera asked him if it wasn't dangerous to keep them so close to each other, but the Master replied they were powerless, so there should be no problem. When Aspheera then decided to leave because the ninja had not brought her staff, Wu was forced to ask her what might keep her there. Aspheera thought about it for a moment, and then said she wanted to take part in a series of contests to test their strength and cunning. Although Wu disagreed at first, when Aspheera turned to leave, he was eventually forced to agree.

The first contest was lifting weights in the courtyard, in which Aspheera won. Wu argued that he was thousands of years old, but the sorceress beat him, saying that she was also thousands of years old.

Another contest was an arm wrestling in the relaxation room, in which Aspheera also won and called Wu a Wu-ser. The Master asked her if they were done, but Aspheera told him that not even close.

The next contest was playing pool. When Aspheera won using Wu's staff, she threw it back into the hands of the "Treacherous Deceiver."

The penultimate contest was a staring contest. Aspheera, however, won again when she startled Wu with her tongue in the eye and he blinked.

The last contest was a pancake flipping, which Wu was also not very good at, and with constant distraction from the sorceress, he failed to flip a single pancake correctly, as they all stuck to the ceiling and then fell on his hat.

After the contest, Wu returned to the hangar abay and asked Skylor how Nya was doing. He then noticed one pancake on his hat and threw it behind him. However, Skylor's powers then disappeared and Nya began to drown. Wu apologized to her and watched her. At that moment, however, the ninja returned and Zane froze Nya again. Lloyd then handed over the staff to Aspheera, who, however, immediately began to shoot energy blasts on the ninja. Wu was almost hit, but Zane saved him. When Lloyd couldn't believe that Aspheera had betrayed them so quickly, Wu ironically reminded him that it was he who had warned them about her.

When police helicopters arrived at the monastery and Aspheera asked Wu if he had betrayed her again and called the police, Wu swore it wasn't him. The ninja then explained that the police came because of them, as Kai revealed their real names during the staff theft. Wu then sighed. Aspheera then used the staff to take away Nya's powers, which worked. Once that happened and Nya turned back into a human, Wu ran up to her and held her in his hands while the New Ninja led the old ninja away. The Teal Ninja then warned Wu, P.I.X.A.L., and Skylor that if they would follow the example of the ninja, they would also go to prison.

Wu then took Nya and carried her to the relaxation room, where he laid her on the couch and told her she was finally back.

Ninjago City vs. Ninja[]

Some time later, Wu attended a court of the ninja. Before the judge entered the room, Skylor had pointed out that the judge might go easy on them, but Wu had replied that he was nicknamed "Toughbutt." When the judge announced the five years prison sentence, Wu, like the others in the room, was shocked and subsequently very disappointed.

After they returned to the monastery, Wu told Dareth that the ninja could not blame anyone but themselves, and when Nya disagreed, he explained that although he was happy they freed Aspheera to save Nya, it didn't change the fact that they had broken the law. When Skylor told him that Nya must feel terrible and powerless, Wu explained that Nya had never been powerless, even before she became a ninja, and that he believed she would find herself again.

Kryptarium Prison Blues[]

The next day, Wu came to Nya's room and asked her what she was doing as she packed her things in boxes. When she explained that she was throwing away things she no longer needed, Wu tried to explain her that when people get upset, they do rash things, like throwing away all their possessions and that she was not defined by her Elemental Power. Then he noticed a letter lying on her bed about how she had once rescued someone as Samurai X and handed it to her to think about who she wanted to be now.

The Spider's Design[]

A few days later, when the ninja had already escaped from prison, Hounddog McBrag arrived at the Monastery of Spinjitzu with several police officers to confiscate the Destiny's Bounty. When they knocked on the monastery gate, Wu opened it and asked what they wanted. As soon as he learned that they wanted to seize the Bounty, he became angry and determined to defend the ship, but finally realized that it would do no one any good and let the officers into the yard. Hounddog then handed Wu an envelope from the postman they met along the way. The Master noticed that the envelope containing the newspaper clippings from an unknown person was open, but before he could do anything about it, Hounddog asked him if he knew where the ninja were. Wu replied that even if he knew, he wouldn't tell him. However, the Marshal threatened him that if he was caught helping the ninja, he would have to detain him. To this information, Wu just coldly replied that it would be interesting to see. After this conversation, Hounddog left and the officers flew off with the Bounty, but it destroyed the monastery wall, forcing Wu to sigh.

Wu then went to the hangar bay where, with the help of P.I.X.A.L. he contacted the ninja in the subway tunnels and told them what had happened.

Some time later, when Harumi detonated the spider bombs in the N line, the ninja disappeared from the map in the hangar, which Wu was horrified and didn't know what happened.

The Fall of the Monastery[]

Wu, P.I.X.A.L., Nya, and Skylor were discussing what might have happened to the ninja shortly after the explosion, which they didn't know about. But then the emergency elevator was activated, and since no one knew who was in it, they all went down to the platform in front of the elevator. As the door opened, four members of the Council of the Crystal King stepped out, Aspheera, Pythor, Vangelis, and the Mechanic. Although Aspheera claimed that they had come for revenge, Vangelis eventually revealed that they wanted the Weapons of Spinjitzu, to which Wu replied to let them come for them and got into a battle pose. He ran forward like the others and attacked Aspheera standing in front of him. However, the Serpentine sorceress used Spinjitzu and threw the master into the stairwell, but that didn't stop him and he immediately went back into the fight. Wu then began to fight Vangelis and managed to drop him to the ground after kicking him.

Meanwhile, the council members managed to take down Skylor, Nya, and P.I.X.A.L. and so Wu was left standing alone against Aspheera, Vangelis and the Mechanic as Pythor held Nya hostage for the time being. The Mechanic mockingly informed Wu that even he couldn't defeat the three of them alone, but Wu confidently replied that they would find out.

He then ran towards them and attacked them with his bo staff. The hat, which he threw up like a discus, hit Vangelis and knocked him down. With the cape he had untied and threw in her face, he blinded Aspheera, and forced her to crash into the wall. He then grabbed the Mechanic's fired robo-arm in his hand and threw it away and tried to attack him, but Aspheera activated a secret Golden Weapons locker that hit him and knocked him away.

Meanwhile, P.I.X.A.L., Nya, and Skylor teamed up and the Nindroid activated the MiniPix, small droids ready to fight the Council. Wu ran towards Aspheera who was trying to get the Golden Weapons and threw her to another platform where he attacked her with his staff and tried to defeat her. He managed to corner her, but then the Crystal Spiders arrived in another elevator and equalized. Aspheera managed to blast Wu to the other end of the hangar with her magic, where he lay down and was subsequently overwhelmed by the debris of the destroyed base.

After the Council obtained the Golden Weapons, they set the spider bombs in the hangar bay and left Wu and the others there to die. However, the last MiniPix finally managed to get everyone except Nya into the elevator and then into the courtyard. When Wu woke up, he realized that Nya wasn't there and ran towards the monastery. But at that moment, the bombs exploded and the whole building caught fire.

Horrified, Wu still tried to run inside, despite Skylor's warning. But then a part of the monastery exploded and threw Wu away. However, he immediately stood up and ran after Nya again, but P.I.X.A.L. and Skylor stopped him. It was then that the master realized that he had lost everything. The ninja, Nya and also his father's monastery and he knelt on the ground, looking at his burning home.

However, just then, the Samurai X Mech flew out of the monastery, controlled by Nya, who landed in the courtyard. Wu was happy that she was alive and even more so when Zane managed to contact P.I.X.A.L. and tell her that they are alive but trapped in a tunnel. Wu didn't hesitate and immediately sent Nya to rush to save their friends, wishing her good luck.

Darkness Within[]

Wu along with P.I.X.A.L. and Skylor then decided to go to the old ninja base, Samurai X Cave, which they had prepared for reuse. When the ninja and Nya finally returned, Wu greeted them and told them that he was afraid that Harumi was behind it and that they had destroyed their home. Although Cole tried to comfort the master by saying that home is where all of them are. However, Wu reminded him that they were not all. Lloyd was missing.

The Coming of the King[]

After the ninja and their allies got a little familiar with the new environment, they started repairing the mech that was there. Kai and Cole were working on the drill, but it caught fire and Wu had to put it out with a fire extinguisher. The computer then started beeping what Wu thought was a smoke alarm and asked Zane to turn it off. However, the Nindroid informed him that it was not a smoke alarm, but Lloyd's tracker. The Green Ninja was in Primeval's Eye. Wu realized that they would need the Destiny's Bounty to find him, but that would mean stealing it and breaking the law again. Wu therefore asked the ninja if they were willing to do so. With everyone agreeing, they immediately set to work to come up with a plan.

Return to Primeval's Eye[]

Following the agreed upon plan, the ninja went to the impound where they secretly attempted to steal their vehicles. However, two security guards spotted Zane getting into his jet and called headquarters. However, before the younger guard could say anything, Wu knocked the walkie-talkie out of his hand with his staff and locked the two guards in their station.

Surprised that the Master was there, Zane said he thought Wu had stayed in the cave. The Master retorted that when they broke into Borg Tower to save Nya, he had chosen the path of the law over his own conscience, something he was not going to do again. Zane told him he was glad the Master was there with them and then they left with the others. Wu then jumped onto the Bounty's anchor and was taken aboard, where he told Nya to set a course for Primeval's Eye.

Some time later, as Harumi chased Lloyd to the edge of the cliff, the Destiny's Bounty appeared behind him and Wu shouted at Lloyd to get on quickly. Although he succeeded, the Green Ninja did not have time to meet his friends as the ship was attacked by members of the Council on their Dragonides. Wu was caught by the crystalized Sword of Fire in Aspheera's hands, prompting her to make fun of him again. However, Wu then called Zane, who flew in with his jet and started shooting at the Dragonides, forcing them to stop attacking the Bounty. Wu and Nya then looked up at the sky where they spotted the floating Crystal Island. Lloyd then told them that the Overlord had returned, prompting Wu to contact the other ninja and tell them to retreat as they were not ready for the Overlord yet.

Crystastrophe[]

While the ninja tried to defeat the crystal army, Lloyd, Nya and Wu remained on the Destiny's Bounty. As Nya wondered how the Overlord could have returned, Wu clarified to her that the Overlord could not be destroyed. Since he was the embodiment of evil, he was fed by anger, hatred, and conflict and as they built up over time, he could gain his strength, and ultimately take form again. Wu knew he would return, but he thought it would be in a several generations. He couldn't believe how he could have missed it when he realized someone was trying to warn him. He explained to Lloyd and Nya that someone had been sending him random newspaper clippings about crimes in Ninjago for months, but he didn't know who they were from. Lloyd noticed that there were symbols on the clippings that the paperboys might recognize and decided to go to them with Wu to find out who sensed that the Overlord was returning.

Lloyd and Wu then visited the paperboys at their warehouse and asked Antonia for the address from the clippings. Although she didn't know it, Nelson gave them the exact address and, to their surprise, the identity of the apartment's occupant, who was Vinny Folson of NGTV News.

The two then went to 833 Andreasen Avenue, to apartment 22, where they knocked on the door. When they opened, to both Lloyd's and Wu's surprise, the former Emperor of Ninjago, Garmadon, stood inside.

Christofern[]

Garmadon then let his brother and son into the apartment and asked them what they needed. Wu, who was confused, began to question Garmadon about what he was doing in Ninjago City, if they had been there for a while, and why he was sending him newspaper clippings. Garmadon, who had hoped to avoid this conversation, finally began to tell his story after defeating the Oni.

When he was done, Wu smiled and told him that he was happy that Garmadon had come such a long way and changed and asked him how. Garmadon told him that he had been given something by Vinny to take care of, a plant called Christofern. However, Lloyd could not believe that Wu trusted him, as he believed that his father could not change. Wu then asked his brother why he was sending him the clippings and preferred not to tell him about the Overlord's return, to which Garmadon replied that he wanted to be left alone. Lloyd, angry with his father then convinced the Master to leave.

However, as soon as they left the apartment, they heard an explosion and quickly returned, only to see Garmadon lying next to the damaged Christofern. The angry older brother transformed into an Oni and began destroying the Crystal Warriors in the street below. Wu then realized that the only way to stop the Overlord's forces was the Oni Power and that Lloyd must embrace his Oni side before it was too late.

A Lesson in Anger[]

When the ninja returned from fighting the Crystal Warriors, Wu and the others were already waiting for them in the Samurai X Cave. The Master then told them that it was possible that they had found a way to stop the Vengestone army. He then explained to them that just as the Elemental Powers came from the dragons, the Oni Form came from the Oni and was the only known option to resist the forces of evil. When Kai asked him how he knew that, Garmadon appeared behind the ninja and they immediately tried to protect their master, but Wu stopped them. He then revealed to them that he and Lloyd had seen Garmadon use Oni Form to stop the Crystal Warriors, and that since Lloyd was also part Oni, he should have that ability as well. Wu then expressed his doubts about the whole thing, but Garmadon told him that he had changed since their last meeting and that he would be a kind and patient teacher for Lloyd.

Wu then, along with the ninja and the others, observed Lloyd's training, but it contradicted all of Wu's teachings. However, when Garmadon mentioned that all things have an opposite, Wu stopped them as he realized they might have another option. He told them that as long as the Oni Form existed, the Dragon Form could also exist. He then realized that Misako was still in the Library of Domu and could find out something about it, so he asked P.I.X.A.L. to go with him to contact her.

When the Master returned, he saw Garmadon yelling at Lloyd, so he stood up for him, saying he was doing his best. Garmadon then turned on Wu and called him a poor teacher, which shocked Wu and forced the ninja to defend him. However, Zane stopped a possible argument by saying that they must not waste time and when P.I.X.A.L. showed the ninja their improved vehicles, they decided to go to Ninjago City to fight. Once they left, Garmadon turned to Wu and told him the truth that the ninja did not stand a chance.

Brave But Foolish[]

While the ninja went to the city to fight, Wu donned the Dragon Armor with a few upgrades made by P.I.X.A.L. and went along with Nya, Lloyd and Garmadon on the Destiny's Bounty. When he entered the control room, he surprised Lloyd by wearing the Dragon Armor but Wu replied that he would not sit out the battle against the very forces of darkness. Garmadon asked him about that if he didn't think the armor would help him fight the Overlord, which angered Lloyd as he was hoping for something positive. He then left the room and Wu ran after him.

However, when they went aboard, the Bounty began to be attacked by the Dragonides as they got too close to the Crystal Island. Wu fought the beasts using Spinjitzu and the Dragonbone Blade, but it wasn't enough. He finally decided to jump off the ship and used the artificial wings attached to his armor to fly all the way to the island and landed on it.

The Master then climbed to the top, where the Overlord was already waiting for him and greeted him by asking if he really thought he had a chance against him. Wu, who was aware that he could not win, replied that even if not, he would oppose him to his last breath. He then used Spinjitzu and attacked the Overlord, but he stopped Wu's blade with his hand. The brave master then attacked again, talking about how his father used to tell him stories about the Overlord and how he was afraid of him, but that he wasn't anymore, realizing that every story ended with the Overlord's defeat.

The Master continued to fight against the Crystal King, dodging the crystal shards that the Overlord threw at him. However, he failed to avoid a powerful blow from the Overlord himself, which threw him to the edge of the island, where he could only hold on with one hand and the blade fell from his hands. The Overlord told him that since he would oppose him forever, he must be the first to fall and threw him off the cliff with a powerful blast. However, Wu managed to recover and flew away from the island with the help of artificial wings.

Quittin' Time![]

As Wu tried to fly away from the Crystal Island, he was chased by a Dragonide, but the Master managed to escape it. Unfortunately, a second one appeared then and managed to catch Wu's wing and fly with him. Wu, realizing he had no other chance, noticed that there was a canal below them, so when he was directly above it, he detached his wings from his armor and fell into the water.

Fortunately, Nelson and Antonia saw Wu's fall and came to the canal, where Nelson managed to pull Wu out of the water and Antonia gave him CPR. The Master then coughed up the water he drank and was led to the newspaper warehouse with their help.

When they got there, Leroy gave Wu a bottle of water, which he drank before sitting on a chair. Antonia then told him that the Destiny's Bounty has been destroyed and no one knew where the ninja were. Wu was horrified and scared at first, but then he realized that the ninja have been through worse. Nelson then asked Wu what the plan was for a counterattack, which shocked the Master and he told the paperboys that there would be no counterattack and that he had to get them all to safety. The paperboys disagreed and tried to convince him that despite being just children, they delivered newspapers during crises. However, Wu disagreed with them and told them that he only led the ninja into battle because he thought they had a chance. But he was wrong.

Wu then convinced the paperboys to get on their bikes and explained that once they got out of the warehouse, they were to go to the edge of the city and avoid contact with the Crystal Warriors. But then he heard the screams of people on the street and decided to help. He took the only weapon he had at hand, a broom, and went outside. He started fighting the Crystal Warriors and managed to defeat many, but it wasn't enough. Then the paperboys also came out of the warehouse and destroyed the warriors with large stocks of newspapers. Wu was shocked and surprised at their involvement and told the paperboys to put their bikes down with the explanation that the ninja never quit.

Master Wu then returned to the warehouse and decided to broadcast a message to the ninja and citizens of the city over the old radio. He said that even though the enemies were attacking their city and wanted to destroy all that was good, they would fail in the end. Because the forces of good were stronger. The news never sleeps. And everyone who listened was an honorary ninja. And the ninja never quit.

Return of the Ice Emperor[]

Over the next few hours, Wu and the paperboys managed to rescue a number of citizens and house them in the paperboys warehouse. When Antonia brought more people, Misako was among them who wanted to talk to Wu. When the Master recognized her voice, he got up from the table and hugged his old friend. He then asked her if she had found anything in the Library of Domu.

Misako then spread the scroll she brought from the library on the table. She explained to Wu that it was a prophecy about the Dragon Form from Quanish the Elder. Wu was not happy with this information as he believed that Quanish was a fool. However, Misako told him that it was their only option, but she didn't know how to read the text on the scroll. So Wu realized that their only option was to rely on the images, and that they had to believe that Quanish wasn't as foolish as he thought.

Safe Haven[]

When Wu brought two bowls of noodles for some people to warm up, a pair asked him to go out to find their son. However, Wu asked them to stay inside as they would have no chance outside and would be infected sooner or later.

That's when Cole, Kai, Skylor, and Jake entered the warehouse, who immediately found his parents, whom Wu was talking to. The Master immediately noticed his students and hugged Kai and Cole at the same time. Then Wu told them that they had a lot of work ahead of them, so they separated from the citizens and went to prepare.

Compatible[]

Some time later, Wu got to examining the scroll that Misako had found in the Library of Domu. As he tried to read the text, he became annoyed at not knowing the language used. Misako tried to calm him down, but just then Cole announced to the others that he had managed to adjust the dispatch radio to the same frequency as the ninja and asked Wu if he wanted to say anything. The Master took the device in his hand and successfully connected with the other ninja. Cole then wanted to tell them where their hideout was, but Wu stopped him, saying that their signal could be intercepted.

Nya and Jay then let their friends know that they were trying to call Benthomaar for help, which Wu seconded. Then he realized that they could ask Queen Vania for help as well. Everyone agreed, and Cole, along with Vinny and Blazey H. Speed, left the warehouse and headed to the NGTV broadcast tower.

Distress Calls[]

While the ninja were trying to call for help, Wu contacted them using the old radio and asked if they had managed to send out distress calls. After learning that neither was sure if the plan had worked, Wu told them to go back and find another way to stop the Overlord. He then dropped the device to the ground and walked out onto the roof of the warehouse from where he looked up at the floating Crystal Island realizing that there might be no other way.

An Issue of Trust[]

While Wu and Misako were studying the scroll again, Nelson ran up to tell him that the ninja and Garmadon had returned. Wu therefore went out into the street to greet the ninja who informed him that they were helpless. However, Wu told them that they still had allies and pointed to Ronin, Killow, Ultra Violet and Fugi-Dove. He then invited them inside and showed them the scroll, explaining that it was the final prophecy of Quanish the Elder, which foretold the final battle against the forces of evil, and the only possible victory could be by achieving the Dragon Form. Garmadon asked him how to achieve this form, but Wu wasn't sure. However, he showed them the images on the scroll and so the ninja decided to do what was shown on them.

As the ninja tried to follow the images that showed them to jump up, kick back, whip around, and spin, Wu and Garmadon watched them, but since nothing was happening, they began to lose hope. Wu finally threw the scroll to the ground in a fit of rage and left, but Nelson noticed that the paper was folded. Cole then called Wu and folded the whole scroll so that the text could be read. Wu recognized the Old Tongue and read the ninja the prophecy: "Only if the allies unite through a selfless act, will main and might prevail the light, and dragon take flight." However, before they could do anything, Cyrus Borg contacted them and revealed that the Overlord's Crystal Island was heading their way.

Garmadon therefore decided that he would go fight the Overlord, but Wu would not let him go alone. Lloyd therefore decided to go with him, but when the other ninja were about to join in, Wu stopped them, saying that they needed to get the Overlord's attention while Lloyd and Garmadon attacked from behind. Although Zane wasn't sure if they could defend one warehouse, Wu believed it was not impossible.

The Master then explained his plan to them, saying that he, along with the ninja and allies they had, would stand outside the warehouse ready to fight. As soon as the Crystal Warriors appeared in the street with the Council of the Crystal King, Wu and the others ran towards them to fight them.

Dragon Form[]

Wu and the ninja began to fight the crystal army, but were unable to win. That's when the Merlopians and the Keepers appeared, having received the message from Nya, as well as the Army of Shintaro. Other ninja allies also appeared and Wu realized the meaning of the prophecy. He therefore yelled at the ninja to try again to achieve the Dragon Form, which they did and it finally worked, much to Wu's amazement.

When the Council members lost their Weapons of Destruction and were regained by the ninja, Wu realized that the Crystal Warriors were weakened and could be destroyed. That's why he started attacking them together with the others.

Even though the plan worked, as the Crystal Island got closer, Wu realized the truth. The Overlord didn't want to destroy the ninja but to corrupt the powers of Creation and it was too late to stop him.

Roots[]

At that moment, Wu realized that their last chance was to unite the Weapons of Spinjitzu. Over the objections of the ninja, Wu knew that they had to destroy the weapons so that their energy could be released and the Overlord could not take it. They finally decided to do as their master asked and flew to the roof of a nearby building, leaving Wu with Nya and Misako on the street.

When the ninja managed to unite their weapons, their Elemental Powers turned into their original form, the Golden Ultra Dragon and Lloyd used it to destroy the Overlord's physical form. Wu, who was watching everything from the ground together with Nya, couldn't believe that it actually happened.

When the dragon landed on the newspaper warehouse where the ninja were waiting, Wu and the others ran after them and as soon as they arrived, Wu expressed how proud he was of his brother. The Golden Ultra Dragon then disappeared to the ninja's surprise, so Wu explained to them that the Powers of Creation had returned to where they came from. Kai asked him if he thought they would ever return and the Master agreed, believing that true power was never lost. Cole then asked Wu what they were going to do and the Master told him that they would do what they always do, rebuild.

Wu and the ninja then returned to the Monastery of Spinjitzu and began repairing it. Wu stood on the wall and watched as the ninja lifted the gate and fixed it in place. That was when Dareth came running after them, saying that they would need help. When Wu saw a number of their friends along with Garmadon going up the stairs to help them with the repairs, Wu smiled and jumped down to his brother, entering the courtyard with him. He stood there, smiling and watching. And when he saw his nephew and brother helping each other, he just expressed that it was simply remarkable.

Dragons Rising, Season 1

Dragons Rising, Season 1[]

Sometime after the Monastery of Spinjitzu was rebuilt, Wu began his studies of the Merge to prevent it, calling it "the Coalescence." He sent Lloyd to look through all the scrolls containing information about the Coalescence, though Lloyd had no idea what it was. When Lloyd came to Wu in the library and gave him the new scrolls, Wu read one and told himself in horror that this was impossible since it was centuries ago. Lloyd, not understanding what was going on, wanted to leave, but Wu stopped him. He then told him that he hoped for Lloyd to be a better master of the Monastery than he was and that family was the key. Lloyd's next confused speech was interrupted by a strong quake that destroyed the wall of the room. As the event took place, Wu came to the understanding that the Merge had already begun, but he was unclear about what instigated it.

Both Wu and Lloyd then ran out into the courtyard where the other ninja were already and looked in horror at the sky where the Merge had just begun. Several portals to other realms opened and they all began to merge. The ninja then went into the city with the Bounty to save as many citizens as possible. When the Bounty went into the Merge, Wu mouthed to himself that he thought he could "pull it off," but that "it happened too soon," to which the ninja couldn't hear due to the raging loud storm. He then told the ninja that only unity can save them, and that they will have no chance if they're separated.[65] When the Merge ended and the portals closed, Wu and the other ninja disappeared without a trace.[66] Wu lost his physical form and became a spirit. The spirit divided into four pieces; three traveled to other realms, while one remained in Ninjago. The realms included the Cloud Kingdom, Imperium, and Mysterium. The fragment that went to Mysterium stayed with Gandalaria at the Monastery of Mysterium, where it was named Sprite.[67][68]
